## SEM

### Helper functions

```{r SEM-helpers-1, eval=T, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

# 1) distance-aware blocks (returns copy)
make_distance_blocks <- function(dt_chr, window_bp, max_block_span = 1e6, gap_factor = 4L) {
  # Defensive checks
  if (!inherits(dt_chr, "data.table")) dt_chr <- as.data.table(dt_chr)
  stopifnot("midpoint" %in% names(dt_chr))
  dt_chr <- copy(dt_chr)
  dt_chr <- dt_chr[order(midpoint)]

  # Parameters
  max_gap <- as.numeric(window_bp) * as.numeric(gap_factor)
  pos <- dt_chr$midpoint
  if (length(pos) < 2) {
    dt_chr[, block_id := 1L]
    return(dt_chr)
  }

  # Assign initial block IDs based on gaps
  gaps <- c(0, diff(pos))
  block_id <- cumsum(gaps > max_gap) + 1L
  dt_chr[, block_id := block_id]

  # Compute span per block
  dt_chr[, span := max(midpoint) - min(midpoint), by = block_id]

  # Split oversized blocks
  if (any(dt_chr$span > max_block_span)) {
    window_limit <- max(2L, floor(max_block_span / window_bp))
    dt_chr[, block_seq := seq_len(.N), by = block_id]
    dt_chr[, block_id := block_id + floor((block_seq - 1L) / window_limit)]
    dt_chr[, c("block_seq", "span") := NULL]
  } else {
    dt_chr[, span := NULL]
  }

  return(dt_chr)
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) estimate_decay_per_chr_robust
#    Robustly estimate an exponential covariance decay (sigma2 * exp(-alpha d))
#    from residuals of a linear model on a single chromosome (or subset).
#    Returns a list with alpha, sigma2, method, n_pairs, n_bins, binned (data.table)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
estimate_decay_per_chr_robust <- function(dt_chr,
                                          formula = NULL,
                                          resp = NULL,
                                          predictors = NULL,
                                          min_pairs = 30L,
                                          max_pair_distance = 2e5,
                                          n_bins = 50L,
                                          trim_prop = 0.02,
                                          start_alpha = 1e-6,
                                          start_s2 = NULL,
                                          lower_alpha = 1e-12,
                                          upper_alpha = 1,
                                          lower_s2 = 1e-12,
                                          upper_s2 = Inf,
                                          nls_control = nls.control(warnOnly = TRUE, maxiter = 200),
                                          min_sigma2 = 1e-8,
                                          min_alpha = 1e-10,
                                          borrow_alpha = NA_real_,
                                          return_binned = TRUE,
                                          verbose = FALSE) {
  # Defensive input handling
  if (!inherits(dt_chr, "data.table")) dt_chr <- as.data.table(dt_chr)
  if (!is.null(formula) && (!is.null(resp) || !is.null(predictors))) {
    stop("Provide either 'formula' or both 'resp' and 'predictors', not both.")
  }
  if (is.null(formula) && (is.null(resp) || is.null(predictors))) {
    stop("Must provide either 'formula' or both 'resp' and 'predictors'.")
  }
  if (!"midpoint" %in% names(dt_chr)) {
    return(list(alpha = NA_real_, sigma2 = NA_real_, method = "missing_midpoint", n_pairs = 0L, n_bins = 0L, binned = NULL, fallback_reasons = NA_character_))
  }

  # Fit OLS (try-catch)
  ols <- tryCatch({
    if (!is.null(formula)) lm(formula, data = dt_chr)
    else lm(as.formula(sprintf("%s ~ %s", resp, paste(predictors, collapse = " + "))), data = dt_chr)
  }, error = function(e) {
    if (verbose) message("OLS fit failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  })

  if (is.null(ols)) {
    return(list(alpha = NA_real_, sigma2 = NA_real_, method = "ols_fail", n_pairs = 0L, n_bins = 0L, binned = NULL, fallback_reasons = "ols_fail"))
  }

  resid_vec <- resid(ols)
  pos <- dt_chr$midpoint
  # keep only finite pairs for pos and residuals
  ok_idx <- which(is.finite(pos) & is.finite(resid_vec))
  if (length(ok_idx) < 4L) {
    return(list(alpha = NA_real_, sigma2 = var(resid_vec, na.rm = TRUE), method = "insufficient_windows", n_pairs = 0L, n_bins = 0L, binned = NULL, fallback_reasons = "insufficient_windows"))
  }
  pos <- as.numeric(pos[ok_idx])
  resid_vec <- as.numeric(resid_vec[ok_idx])
  n <- length(pos)

  # build pair indices (i < j) memory-efficiently
  # If n is small, build full matrix of indices; if n large, build by chunks
  make_pair_index <- function(n, chunk_limit = 2000L) {
    if (n <= chunk_limit) {
      # all pairs
      ij <- utils::combn(n, 2)
      return(t(ij))
    }
    # chunked approach: create pairs by iterating i and creating j ranges
    rows <- vector("list", n - 1L)
    for (i in seq_len(n - 1L)) {
      js <- (i + 1L):n
      rows[[i]] <- cbind(i = rep(i, length(js)), j = js)
    }
    do.call(rbind, rows)
  }

  idx <- tryCatch(make_pair_index(n), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(idx) || nrow(idx) == 0L) {
    return(list(alpha = NA_real_, sigma2 = var(resid_vec, na.rm = TRUE), method = "no_pairs", n_pairs = 0L, n_bins = 0L, binned = NULL, fallback_reasons = "no_pairs"))
  }

  # distances and covariance products; filter by max_pair_distance
  dvec <- abs(pos[idx[, 1L]] - pos[idx[, 2L]])
  covvec <- resid_vec[idx[, 1L]] * resid_vec[idx[, 2L]]
  valid_pairs <- which(is.finite(dvec) & is.finite(covvec) & dvec <= max_pair_distance)
  n_pairs_found <- length(valid_pairs)
  if (n_pairs_found < min_pairs) {
    return(list(alpha = NA_real_, sigma2 = var(resid_vec, na.rm = TRUE), method = "insufficient_pairs", n_pairs = n_pairs_found, n_bins = 0L, binned = NULL, fallback_reasons = "insufficient_pairs"))
  }

  d_ok <- dvec[valid_pairs]
  cov_ok <- covvec[valid_pairs]

  # bin distances into n_bins equal-width bins up to max_pair_distance
  breaks <- seq(0, max_pair_distance, length.out = n_bins + 1L)
  bin_idx <- cut(d_ok, breaks = breaks, include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE)
  bin_dt <- data.table(d = d_ok, cov = cov_ok, bin = bin_idx)

  # compute trimmed mean per bin with minimum observations
  binned <- bin_dt[, {
    if (.N < 3L) .(dmed = median(d), cov_trim = NA_real_, n = .N)
    else {
      lo <- quantile(cov, trim_prop, na.rm = TRUE)
      hi <- quantile(cov, 1 - trim_prop, na.rm = TRUE)
      cov_t <- cov[cov >= lo & cov <= hi]
      .(dmed = median(d), cov_trim = mean(cov_t, na.rm = TRUE), n = .N)
    }
  }, by = bin][!is.na(cov_trim) & n > 0L]

  n_bins_used <- nrow(binned)
  if (n_bins_used < 4L) {
    return(list(alpha = NA_real_, sigma2 = var(resid_vec, na.rm = TRUE), method = "insufficient_bins", n_pairs = n_pairs_found, n_bins = n_bins_used, binned = if (return_binned) binned else NULL, fallback_reasons = "insufficient_bins"))
  }

  # prepare for fitting: ensure cov_trim is non-negative by shifting if needed
  cov_b <- binned$cov_trim
  d_b <- binned$dmed
  cov_shift <- if (any(cov_b <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)) abs(min(cov_b, na.rm = TRUE)) + 1e-12 else 0
  cov_b_nls <- cov_b + cov_shift

  # starting values
  s2_start <- start_s2 %||% max(min_sigma2, var(resid_vec, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
  alpha_start <- max(start_alpha, min_alpha)

  # attempt NLS (port algorithm) with bounded parameters
  nls_fit <- tryCatch({
    nls(cov_b_nls ~ s2 * exp(-alpha * d_b),
        start = list(s2 = s2_start + cov_shift, alpha = alpha_start),
        algorithm = "port",
        lower = c(s2 = lower_s2 + cov_shift, alpha = lower_alpha),
        upper = c(s2 = upper_s2 + cov_shift, alpha = upper_alpha),
        control = nls_control)
  }, error = function(e) {
    if (verbose) message("NLS failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  })

  method <- "nls_binned"
  alpha_hat <- NA_real_
  sigma2_hat <- NA_real_

  if (!is.null(nls_fit)) {
    coefs <- tryCatch(coef(nls_fit), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(coefs) && all(c("s2", "alpha") %in% names(coefs))) {
      sigma2_hat <- as.numeric(coefs["s2"]) - cov_shift
      alpha_hat <- as.numeric(coefs["alpha"])
    } else {
      nls_fit <- NULL
    }
  }

  # fallback: log-linear regression on positive covariances
  if (is.null(nls_fit)) {
    ok_log <- which(cov_b > 0 & is.finite(cov_b) & is.finite(d_b))
    if (length(ok_log) >= 3L) {
      lm_fit <- tryCatch(lm(log(cov_b[ok_log]) ~ d_b[ok_log]), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(lm_fit)) {
        coef_lm <- coef(lm_fit)
        sigma2_hat <- exp(coef_lm[1])
        alpha_hat <- -coef_lm[2]
        method <- "loglinear_binned"
      }
    }
  }

  # final fallbacks for sigma2 and alpha
  fallback_reasons <- character(0)
  if (!is.finite(sigma2_hat) || sigma2_hat < min_sigma2) {
    sigma2_hat <- max(min_sigma2, var(resid_vec, na.rm = TRUE))
    fallback_reasons <- c(fallback_reasons, "sigma2_fixed")
    method <- paste0(method, "+sigma2_fixed")
  }
  if (!is.finite(alpha_hat) || alpha_hat < min_alpha) {
    alpha_hat <- if (is.finite(borrow_alpha)) borrow_alpha else min_alpha
    fallback_reasons <- c(fallback_reasons, if (is.finite(borrow_alpha)) "alpha_borrowed" else "alpha_forced_min")
    method <- paste0(method, "+alpha_fixed")
  }

  if (verbose) {
    message(sprintf("Decay fit finished: method=%s alpha=%.4g sigma2=%.4g pairs=%d bins=%d", method, alpha_hat, sigma2_hat, n_pairs_found, n_bins_used))
  }

  list(
    alpha = as.numeric(alpha_hat),
    sigma2 = as.numeric(sigma2_hat),
    method = method,
    n_pairs = n_pairs_found,
    n_bins = n_bins_used,
    binned = if (return_binned) binned else NULL,
    fallback_reasons = if (length(fallback_reasons)) paste(fallback_reasons, collapse = ";") else NA_character_
  )
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) make_block_specs_robust
#    Build distance-aware blocks, estimate decay per chromosome and variable,
#    automatically apply fallbacks (borrowing alpha, fixing sigma2) and log
#    diagnostics. Returns list(block_map = data.table, decay_dt = data.table)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
make_block_specs_robust <- function(dt,
                                    vars,
                                    by_chr = "chrom",
                                    window_bp = NULL,
                                    max_block_span = 1e6,
                                    max_pair_distance = 2e5,
                                    n_bins = 50L,
                                    trim_prop = 0.02,
                                    min_pairs = 30L,
                                    min_sigma2 = 1e-8,
                                    min_alpha = 1e-10,
                                    borrow_alpha_from = NULL, # vector of chromosomes to borrow from, or NULL to use median of successful fits
                                    verbose = FALSE,
                                    ...) {
  if (!"data.table" %in% class(dt)) dt <- as.data.table(dt)
  stopifnot(by_chr %in% names(dt), "midpoint" %in% names(dt))
  # preserve original row index for safe mapping later
  dt[, orig_row__ := .I]

  # Build distance-aware blocks per chromosome by splitting (safe: make_distance_blocks modifies input)
  if (!is.null(window_bp)) {
    dt_list <- split(dt, by = by_chr, keep.by = TRUE)
    dt_blocks_list <- lapply(dt_list, function(dsub) {
      setDT(dsub)
      make_distance_blocks(dsub, window_bp = window_bp, max_block_span = max_block_span)
    })
    dt_blocks <- rbindlist(dt_blocks_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  } else {
    dt_blocks <- copy(dt)
    dt_blocks[, block_id := 1L, by = by_chr]
  }
  # Ensure mapping to original rows
  if (!"orig_row__" %in% names(dt_blocks)) stop("orig_row__ missing from block map; ensure dt had orig_row__ before splitting.")
  block_map <- dt_blocks[, .(orig_row = orig_row__, chrom = get(by_chr), midpoint, block_id)]

  # For each chromosome and variable, run robust estimator and collect binned objects
  decay_records <- list()
  fits_by_var_chr <- list()  # temporary storage for alpha extraction
  for (varname in names(vars)) {
    preds <- vars[[varname]]
    dts_by_chr <- split(dt_blocks, by = by_chr, keep.by = TRUE)
    for (chr_val in names(dts_by_chr)) {
      dt_chr <- dts_by_chr[[chr_val]]
      # call estimator with conservative defaults
      res <- tryCatch(
        estimate_decay_per_chr_robust(dt_chr,
                                      resp = varname,
                                      predictors = preds,
                                      min_pairs = min_pairs,
                                      max_pair_distance = max_pair_distance,
                                      n_bins = n_bins,
                                      trim_prop = trim_prop,
                                      min_sigma2 = min_sigma2,
                                      min_alpha = min_alpha,
                                      return_binned = TRUE,
                                      verbose = FALSE,
                                      ...),
        error = function(e) {
          list(alpha = NA_real_, sigma2 = NA_real_, method = "est_error", n_pairs = 0L, n_bins = 0L, binned = NULL, fallback_reasons = NA_character_)
        })
      fits_by_var_chr[[paste(varname, chr_val, sep = "___")]] <- list(chr = chr_val, var = varname, res = res)
      # populate record now but may adjust later if borrowing alpha applied
      decay_records[[length(decay_records) + 1]] <- data.table(
        chrom = as.character(chr_val),
        variable = varname,
        alpha = res$alpha,
        sigma2 = res$sigma2,
        n_windows = nrow(dt_chr),
        n_pairs = res$n_pairs %||% NA_integer_,
        method = res$method %||% NA_character_,
        fallback_reasons = res$fallback_reasons %||% NA_character_,
        binned = list(res$binned)
      )
    }
  }

  decay_dt <- rbindlist(decay_records, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

  # Determine alpha borrowing source if any alphas are missing or too small
  # Compute median alpha across successful fits (optionally restricted to borrow_alpha_from)
  success_alphas <- decay_dt[is.finite(alpha) & !is.na(alpha) & alpha > 0, .(alpha, chrom, variable)]
  alpha_pool <- success_alphas$alpha
  if (!is.null(borrow_alpha_from)) {
    # restrict alpha_pool to requested chromosomes if present
    alpha_pool <- success_alphas[chrom %in% as.character(borrow_alpha_from), alpha]
  }
  median_alpha_pool <- if (length(alpha_pool) > 0) median(alpha_pool, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
  if (is.na(median_alpha_pool)) {
    # fallback guess if no pool available
    median_alpha_pool <- 1e-6
    if (verbose) message("No valid alpha pool found; using default median_alpha_pool = ", median_alpha_pool)
  }

  # Apply automatic fixes: where sigma2 is NA or < min_sigma2 --> replace with empirical residual variance
  # where alpha is NA or < min_alpha --> borrow median_alpha_pool
  decay_dt[, `:=`(
    sigma2_orig = sigma2,
    alpha_orig = alpha
  )]
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(decay_dt))) {
    row <- decay_dt[i]
    chr_val <- row$chr; varname <- row$variable
    if (is.na(row$sigma2) || row$sigma2 < min_sigma2) {
      # compute empirical residual variance on that chr/var to be stable
      dt_chr_full <- dt_blocks[get(by_chr) == chr_val]
      if (nrow(dt_chr_full) >= 2 && var(dt_chr_full[[varname]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
        new_sigma2 <- var(resid(lm(as.formula(sprintf("%s ~ %s", varname, paste(vars[[varname]], collapse = " + "))), data = dt_chr_full)), na.rm = TRUE)
        if (!is.finite(new_sigma2) || new_sigma2 < min_sigma2) new_sigma2 <- max(min_sigma2, var(dt_chr_full[[varname]], na.rm = TRUE))
      } else {
        new_sigma2 <- max(min_sigma2, ifelse(is.finite(row$sigma2), row$sigma2 %||% min_sigma2, min_sigma2))
      }
      decay_dt[i, `:=`(sigma2 = new_sigma2,
                       method = paste0(method %||% "unknown", "+sigma2_fixed"),
                       fallback_reasons = ifelse(is.na(fallback_reasons), "sigma2_fixed", paste(fallback_reasons, "sigma2_fixed", sep = ";")))]
      if (verbose) message("Fixed sigma2 for ", varname, " chrom ", chr_val, " -> ", signif(new_sigma2,4))
    }
    if (is.na(row$alpha) || row$alpha < min_alpha) {
      decay_dt[i, `:=`(alpha = median_alpha_pool,
                       method = paste0(method %||% "unknown", "+alpha_borrowed"),
                       fallback_reasons = ifelse(is.na(fallback_reasons), "alpha_borrowed", paste(fallback_reasons, "alpha_borrowed", sep = ";")))]
      if (verbose) message("Borrowed alpha for ", varname, " chrom ", chr_val, " -> ", signif(median_alpha_pool,4))
    }
  }

  # Return block_map and decay_dt (binned retained as list column)
  setcolorder(decay_dt, c("chrom", "variable", "alpha", "sigma2", "n_windows", "n_pairs", "method", "fallback_reasons", "binned", "alpha_orig", "sigma2_orig"))
  list(block_map = block_map, decay_dt = decay_dt[])
}

# 4) build_exp_cov: build sparse exp covariance for positions
build_exp_cov <- function(pos, alpha, sigma2, max_pair_distance = Inf, tol = 1e-12) {
  if (!is.numeric(pos) || length(pos) == 0) return(Matrix::Matrix(0, 0, 0, sparse = TRUE))
  n <- length(pos)
  if (n == 1) return(Matrix::Matrix(sigma2, 1, 1, sparse = TRUE))

  if (is.na(alpha) || !is.finite(alpha) || alpha <= 0) {
    return(Matrix::Diagonal(n = n, x = rep(sigma2, n)))
  }

  # compute pairwise distances in a memory-efficient triangular loop
  i_list <- integer(0); j_list <- integer(0); x_list <- numeric(0)
  for (i in seq_len(n - 1L)) {
    dvec <- abs(pos[(i + 1L):n] - pos[i])
    keep <- which(dvec <= max_pair_distance)
    if (length(keep) == 0L) next
    js <- (i + keep)
    vals <- sigma2 * exp(-alpha * dvec[keep])
    keep2 <- which(abs(vals) >= tol)
    if (length(keep2) == 0L) next
    js2 <- js[keep2]; vals2 <- vals[keep2]
    # store both upper and lower entries
    i_list <- c(i_list, rep(i, length(js2)), js2)
    j_list <- c(j_list, js2, rep(i, length(js2)))
    x_list <- c(x_list, vals2, vals2)
  }
  # diagonal
  i_list <- c(i_list, seq_len(n))
  j_list <- c(j_list, seq_len(n))
  x_list <- c(x_list, rep(sigma2, n))

  # construct sparse matrix without claiming triangular storage; class will be dgCMatrix
  mat <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(i = i_list, j = j_list, x = x_list, dims = c(n, n), symmetric = FALSE)
  # ensure explicit symmetry and convert to compressed symmetric class
  mat_sym <- as(Matrix::forceSymmetric(mat, uplo = "U"), "dsCMatrix")
  mat_sym
}

# 5) make_sparse_cov_blocks: map decay_dt -> sparse blocks
make_sparse_cov_blocks <- function(block_map,
                                   decay_dt,
                                   dt,
                                   by_chr = "chrom",
                                   block_id_col = "block_id",
                                   orig_row_col = "orig_row",
                                   midpoint_col = "midpoint",
                                   variable_col = "variable",
                                   max_pair_distance = 2e5,
                                   key_fun = NULL,
                                   chunk_threshold = 3000L,
                                   sample_pair_cap = 1e6L,
                                   tol_sym = 1e-9,
                                   verbose = FALSE) {
  # Purpose:
  # - Build per-block sparse covariance matrices using an exponential decay model
  # - Return canonical index_map matching each cov matrix ordering
  # - Avoid dense n^2 allocations by enumerating only pairs within max_pair_distance
  # - Attach attr(cov_mat, "positions") = midpoints used to build that block
  #
  # Requirements: data.table, Matrix
  if (!requireNamespace("data.table", quietly = TRUE)) stop("data.table required")
  if (!requireNamespace("Matrix", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Matrix required")
  data.table <- data.table::as.data.table

  # Input validation / canonicalization
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(block_map) || data.table::is.data.table(block_map))
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(decay_dt) || data.table::is.data.table(decay_dt))
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(dt) || data.table::is.data.table(dt))
  block_map <- data.table::as.data.table(block_map)
  decay_dt  <- data.table::as.data.table(decay_dt)
  dt        <- data.table::as.data.table(dt)

  stopifnot(by_chr %in% names(block_map))
  stopifnot(orig_row_col %in% names(block_map))
  stopifnot(midpoint_col %in% names(dt))

  block_map[[by_chr]] <- as.character(block_map[[by_chr]])
  dt[[by_chr]] <- as.character(dt[[by_chr]])
  block_map[[orig_row_col]] <- as.integer(block_map[[orig_row_col]])

  if (is.null(key_fun)) key_fun <- function(chr, bid, var = NULL) paste0(chr, "_", bid)

  full_block_covs <- list()
  diagnostics <- list()
  hiccups <- list()
  index_map_rows <- vector("list", 0L)
  imr_i <- 0L

  # unique block table (stable ordering)
  uniq_blocks <- unique(block_map[, .(block_id = get(block_id_col), chr = get(by_chr))])
  data.table::setorder(uniq_blocks, chr, block_id)

  # iterate blocks
  for (bi in seq_len(nrow(uniq_blocks))) {
    chr_val <- uniq_blocks$chr[bi]
    bid <- uniq_blocks$block_id[bi]

    # select and sanitize block_map rows
    bm <- block_map[get(block_id_col) == bid & get(by_chr) == chr_val, .(orig_row = get(orig_row_col))]
    if (nrow(bm) == 0L) next
    bm[, orig_row := as.integer(orig_row)]
    bm <- bm[!is.na(orig_row) & orig_row >= 1 & orig_row <= nrow(dt)]
    if (nrow(bm) == 0L) next

    # dedupe orig_rows and order by midpoint (canonical order)
    bm <- unique(bm, by = "orig_row")
    bm[, midpoint := dt[orig_row, get(midpoint_col)]]
    data.table::setorder(bm, midpoint)
    orig_rows_ord <- bm$orig_row
    n_windows <- length(orig_rows_ord)
    if (n_windows < 1L) next

    # canonical block data and positions
    dt_block <- dt[orig_rows_ord]
    pos <- as.numeric(dt_block[[midpoint_col]])

    # determine variable + decay params for this chr
    decay_chr <- decay_dt[get(by_chr) == chr_val]
    if (nrow(decay_chr) == 0L) {
      hiccups[[length(hiccups) + 1L]] <- list(key = paste0(chr_val, "_", bid), reason = "no_decay_info")
      next
    }
    vars_candidates <- unique(as.character(decay_chr[[variable_col]]))
    varname <- NULL
    for (v in vars_candidates) if (!is.null(v) && v %in% names(dt_block)) { varname <- v; break }
    if (is.null(varname)) varname <- as.character(decay_chr[[variable_col]][1])

    decay_row <- decay_dt[get(by_chr) == chr_val & get(variable_col) == varname]
    if (nrow(decay_row) == 0L) decay_row <- decay_dt[get(by_chr) == chr_val][1]
    if (nrow(decay_row) == 0L) {
      hiccups[[length(hiccups) + 1L]] <- list(key = paste0(chr_val, "_", bid), reason = "decay_missing")
      next
    }
    alpha <- as.numeric(decay_row$alpha[1]); sigma2 <- as.numeric(decay_row$sigma2[1])
    if (!is.finite(alpha) || alpha <= 0) alpha <- 1e-6
    if (!is.finite(sigma2) || sigma2 <= 0) sigma2 <- max(1e-12, var(dt_block[[varname]], na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)

    # build pair lists limited by max_pair_distance (chunked when needed)
    i_list <- integer(0); j_list <- integer(0); v_list <- numeric(0)
    if (n_windows <= chunk_threshold) {
      for (i in seq_len(n_windows - 1L)) {
        jmax <- findInterval(pos[i] + max_pair_distance, pos)
        if (jmax > i) {
          js <- (i + 1L):jmax
          i_list <- c(i_list, rep(i, length(js)))
          j_list <- c(j_list, js)
          v_list <- c(v_list, sigma2 * exp(-alpha * (pos[js] - pos[i])))
        }
      }
    } else {
      chunk_size <- chunk_threshold
      for (start in seq(1L, n_windows - 1L, by = chunk_size)) {
        end <- min(n_windows - 1L, start + chunk_size - 1L)
        for (i in start:end) {
          jmax <- findInterval(pos[i] + max_pair_distance, pos)
          if (jmax > i) {
            js <- (i + 1L):jmax
            i_list <- c(i_list, rep(i, length(js)))
            j_list <- c(j_list, js)
            v_list <- c(v_list, sigma2 * exp(-alpha * (pos[js] - pos[i])))
          }
        }
        if (length(i_list) > sample_pair_cap) {
          samp <- sample(seq_along(i_list), size = sample_pair_cap)
          i_list <- i_list[samp]; j_list <- j_list[samp]; v_list <- v_list[samp]
          if (verbose) message("Large block sampled pair set for ", chr_val, "_", bid)
          break
        }
      }
    }

    # assemble sparse symmetric covariance robustly
    cov_mat <- NULL
    if (length(i_list) == 0L) {
      cov_mat <- Matrix::Diagonal(n = n_windows, x = rep(sigma2, n_windows))
      # convert diag to sparse symmetric dsCMatrix
      cov_mat <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(i = seq_len(n_windows), j = seq_len(n_windows), x = diag(cov_mat), dims = c(n_windows, n_windows), symmetric = TRUE)
      cov_mat <- methods::as(cov_mat, "dsCMatrix")
    } else {
      ii <- i_list; jj <- j_list; vv <- v_list
      ii2 <- c(ii, jj, seq_len(n_windows))
      jj2 <- c(jj, ii, seq_len(n_windows))
      vv2 <- c(vv, vv, rep(sigma2, n_windows))
      sp <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(i = ii2, j = jj2, x = vv2, dims = c(n_windows, n_windows), symmetric = FALSE)
      sp <- (sp + Matrix::t(sp)) / 2
      # ensure numeric stability
      cov_mat <- as(sp, "dgCMatrix")
      # try to coerce to dsCMatrix; handle cases like ddiMatrix specially
      cov_mat <- tryCatch({
        # forceSymmetric handles many cases; but if cov_mat is diagonal or ddiMatrix, handle separately
        sm <- Matrix::forceSymmetric(cov_mat, uplo = "U")
        methods::as(sm, "dsCMatrix")
      }, error = function(e) {
        # fallback: dense symmetrize then sparse
        m_dense <- as.matrix(sp)
        m_sym <- (m_dense + t(m_dense)) / 2
        Matrix::as(m_sym, "dsCMatrix")
      })
    }

    # final sanity on diag and symmetry
    diag_vals <- diag(cov_mat)
    diag_vals[!is.finite(diag_vals) | diag_vals <= 0] <- pmax(1e-12, sigma2)
    diag(cov_mat) <- diag_vals
    max_asym <- max(abs(cov_mat - Matrix::t(cov_mat)))
    if (!is.finite(max_asym) || max_asym > tol_sym) {
      m_dense <- as.matrix(cov_mat)
      m_dense <- (m_dense + t(m_dense)) / 2
      cov_mat <- Matrix::as(m_dense, "dsCMatrix")
    }

    # verify dimensions
    if (nrow(cov_mat) != n_windows || ncol(cov_mat) != n_windows) {
      hiccups[[length(hiccups) + 1L]] <- list(key = paste0(chr_val, "_", bid),
                                              reason = "dim_mismatch",
                                              cov_dim = dim(cov_mat),
                                              n_windows = n_windows)
      next
    }

    # attach canonical positions attribute
    attr(cov_mat, "positions") <- pos

    # store cov and build index_map rows in identical canonical order
    key <- key_fun(chr_val, bid, varname)
    full_block_covs[[key]] <- cov_mat

    for (k in seq_along(orig_rows_ord)) {
      imr_i <- imr_i + 1L
      index_map_rows[[imr_i]] <- list(
        key = key,
        chrom = chr_val,
        block_id = bid,
        variable = varname,
        row_id = as.integer(orig_rows_ord[k]),
        idx = as.integer(k)
      )
    }

    # diagnostics
    diagnostics[[key]] <- list(
      chr = chr_val,
      block_id = bid,
      n_windows = n_windows,
      alpha = alpha,
      sigma2 = sigma2,
      method = as.character(decay_row$method[1] %||% NA_character_),
      fallback = as.character(decay_row$fallback_reasons[1] %||% NA_character_),
      nnz = length(cov_mat@x),
      dims = dim(cov_mat)
    )

    if (verbose && (bi %% 100 == 0 || bi == nrow(uniq_blocks))) {
      message("Processed block ", bi, "/", nrow(uniq_blocks), " key=", key)
    }
  } # end block loop

  # assemble index_map and diagnostics tables
  if (length(index_map_rows) > 0L) {
    index_map <- data.table::rbindlist(index_map_rows, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  } else {
    index_map <- data.table::data.table(key = character(0), chrom = character(0), block_id = integer(0), variable = character(0), row_id = integer(0), idx = integer(0))
  }

  diagnostics_dt <- if (length(diagnostics) > 0L) data.table::rbindlist(lapply(diagnostics, as.data.table), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE) else data.table::data.table()
  hiccup_dt <- if (length(hiccups) > 0L) data.table::rbindlist(lapply(hiccups, as.data.table), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE) else data.table::data.table()

  # final consistency check (warn only)
  bad_keys <- character(0)
  for (k in names(full_block_covs)) {
    n_cov <- nrow(full_block_covs[[k]])
    n_map <- sum(index_map$key == k)
    if (n_cov != n_map) bad_keys <- c(bad_keys, k)
  }
  if (length(bad_keys) > 0L) {
    warning("Inconsistent keys after assembly; problematic keys (first 10): ", paste(head(bad_keys, 10), collapse = ", "))
  }

  out <- list(
    full_block_covs = full_block_covs,
    index_map = index_map,
    diagnostics = diagnostics_dt,
    hiccups = hiccup_dt,
    params = list(by_chr = by_chr, block_id_col = block_id_col, orig_row_col = orig_row_col, midpoint_col = midpoint_col, max_pair_distance = max_pair_distance, chunk_threshold = chunk_threshold)
  )
  class(out) <- c("sparse_cov_blocks", class(out))
  out
}

# 6) Prewhiten variables blockwise
prewhiten_variable_blockwise <- function(varname, dt_sub, sparse_obj,
                                         index_map = NULL,
                                         by_chr = "chrom",
                                         midpoint_col = "midpoint",
                                         verbose = FALSE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("data.table", quietly = TRUE)) stop("data.table required")
  if (!requireNamespace("Matrix", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Matrix required")
  data.table <- data.table::as.data.table

  if (!is.list(sparse_obj) || !"full_block_covs" %in% names(sparse_obj))
    stop("sparse_obj must be a list containing full_block_covs")
  if (!inherits(dt_sub, "data.table")) dt_sub <- data.table::as.data.table(dt_sub)
  if (!by_chr %in% names(dt_sub)) stop("dt_sub must contain column: ", by_chr)
  if (!(varname %in% names(dt_sub))) stop("varname not found in dt_sub")
  dt_sub[[by_chr]] <- as.character(dt_sub[[by_chr]])
  n_rows <- nrow(dt_sub)

  # resolve index_map
  if (!is.null(index_map)) {
    imap <- data.table::as.data.table(index_map)
  } else if (!is.null(sparse_obj$index_map)) {
    imap <- data.table::as.data.table(sparse_obj$index_map)
  } else stop("No index_map found in sparse_obj and none supplied")

  req <- c("key", "chrom", "block_id", "row_id", "idx")
  if (!all(req %in% names(imap))) stop("index_map must contain columns: ", paste(req, collapse = ", "))

  imap[, row_id := as.integer(row_id)]
  if (any(is.na(imap$row_id) | imap$row_id < 1 | imap$row_id > n_rows)) {
    stop("index_map$row_id must be integer row indices into dt_sub (1..nrow(dt_sub))")
  }

  fb_keys <- intersect(names(sparse_obj$full_block_covs), unique(imap$key))
  if (length(fb_keys) == 0) stop("No matching keys between full_block_covs and index_map")

  whitened <- rep(NA_real_, n_rows)
  diag_rows <- vector("list", length(fb_keys))
  li <- 0L

  for (K in sort(fb_keys)) {
    li <- li + 1L
    cov_mat <- sparse_obj$full_block_covs[[K]]
    if (is.null(cov_mat)) {
      diag_rows[[li]] <- list(key = K, n_cov = NA_integer_, n_map = 0L, used = FALSE, reason = "no_cov")
      next
    }

    cov_dim <- tryCatch({ d <- dim(cov_mat); if (is.null(d)) stop("no dim"); d }, error = function(e) c(NA_integer_, NA_integer_))
    n_cov <- as.integer(cov_dim[1])

    # CORRECT selection: use the scalar key K (not the whole column)
    idx_dt <- imap[key == K]
    if (nrow(idx_dt) == 0L) {
      diag_rows[[li]] <- list(key = K, n_cov = n_cov, n_map = 0L, used = FALSE, reason = "no_index_map")
      next
    }
    idx_dt <- idx_dt[order(idx)]
    n_map <- nrow(idx_dt)
    row_positions <- as.integer(idx_dt$row_id)

    if (is.na(n_cov) || n_cov <= 0) {
      diag_rows[[li]] <- list(key = K, n_cov = NA_integer_, n_map = n_map, used = FALSE, reason = "invalid_cov_dim")
      next
    }

    if (n_cov != n_map) {
      pos_attr <- attr(cov_mat, "positions", exact = TRUE)
      if (!is.null(pos_attr) && midpoint_col %in% names(dt_sub)) {
        mp_idx <- dt_sub[row_positions, get(midpoint_col)]
        mm <- match(mp_idx, pos_attr, nomatch = 0L)
        if (length(mm) == n_map && all(mm > 0)) {
          ord_cov <- order(mm)
          row_positions <- row_positions[ord_cov]
          idx_dt <- idx_dt[ord_cov]
          n_map <- length(row_positions)
          if (n_cov != n_map) {
            diag_rows[[li]] <- list(key = K, n_cov = n_cov, n_map = n_map, used = FALSE, reason = "dim_mismatch_after_reorder")
            next
          }
        } else {
          diag_rows[[li]] <- list(key = K, n_cov = n_cov, n_map = n_map, used = FALSE, reason = "dim_mismatch_unresolvable")
          next
        }
      } else {
        diag_rows[[li]] <- list(key = K, n_cov = n_cov, n_map = n_map, used = FALSE, reason = "dim_mismatch_no_positions")
        next
      }
    }

    y_block <- dt_sub[row_positions, get(varname)]
    if (length(y_block) != n_cov) {
      diag_rows[[li]] <- list(key = K, n_cov = n_cov, n_map = n_map, used = FALSE, reason = "y_length_mismatch")
      next
    }
    if (all(is.na(y_block))) {
      diag_rows[[li]] <- list(key = K, n_cov = n_cov, n_map = n_map, used = FALSE, reason = "y_all_na")
      next
    }

    cov_dense <- tryCatch(as.matrix(cov_mat), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(cov_dense) || nrow(cov_dense) != n_cov) {
      diag_rows[[li]] <- list(key = K, n_cov = n_cov, n_map = n_map, used = FALSE, reason = "cov_coerce_fail_or_dim")
      next
    }

    jitter_eps <- 1e-8 * max(1, mean(diag(cov_dense), na.rm = TRUE))
    diag(cov_dense) <- diag(cov_dense) + jitter_eps

    chol_ok <- FALSE; L <- NULL
    try_chol <- try({ L <- chol(cov_dense); chol_ok <- TRUE }, silent = TRUE)

    if (isTRUE(chol_ok) && is.matrix(L)) {
      whiten_block <- backsolve(L, forwardsolve(t(L), y_block))
      used_method <- "chol"
    } else {
      eig <- tryCatch(eigen(cov_dense, symmetric = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(eig)) {
        diag_rows[[li]] <- list(key = K, n_cov = n_cov, n_map = n_map, used = FALSE, reason = "eigen_fail")
        next
      }
      vals_adj <- pmax(eig$values, 1e-12)
      P_sqrt <- eig$vectors %*% diag(1 / sqrt(vals_adj), nrow = length(vals_adj)) %*% t(eig$vectors)
      if (ncol(P_sqrt) != length(y_block)) {
        diag_rows[[li]] <- list(key = K, n_cov = n_cov, n_map = n_map, used = FALSE, reason = "P_sqrt_dim_mismatch")
        next
      }
      whiten_block <- as.numeric(P_sqrt %*% y_block)
      used_method <- "eigen"
    }

    whitened[row_positions] <- whiten_block
    diag_rows[[li]] <- list(key = K, n_cov = n_cov, n_map = n_map, used = TRUE, reason = used_method)
    if (verbose) message("Whitened key=", K, " method=", used_method, " n=", n_cov)
  }

  diag_dt <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(diag_rows, function(x) as.data.table(x)), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  list(whitened = whitened, diagnostics = diag_dt)
}

# 7) wrapper that applies blockwise whitening to a set of variables
prewhiten_all_variables <- function(dt_sub,
                                    vars,
                                    sparse_obj,
                                    whiten_suffix = "_wh",
                                    assemble_cov = FALSE,
                                    cov_assembler = NULL,
                                    parallel = FALSE,
                                    BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam(),
                                    verbose = TRUE) {
  # Purpose:
  # - Prewhiten a set of observed variables blockwise using sparse_obj produced by
  #   make_sparse_cov_blocks().  Returns dt with whitened columns, per-variable diagnostics,
  #   optional assembled block-diagonal covariance matrices, and the original sparse_obj.
  #
  # Arguments:
  # - dt_sub: data.table of windows (must match indices referenced by sparse_obj$index_map$row_id)
  # - vars: character vector of variable names to whiten (must be columns in dt_sub)
  # - sparse_obj: output from make_sparse_cov_blocks() with fields $full_block_covs and $index_map
  # - whiten_suffix: suffix appended to variable names for whitened columns
  # - assemble_cov: logical; if TRUE, attempt cov_assembler(full_block_covs, varname) to build full block-diagonal cov
  # - cov_assembler: function(full_block_covs, varname) -> blockDiag matrix (or NULL). Only used when assemble_cov = TRUE.
  # - parallel: logical; if TRUE uses BiocParallel::bplapply with provided BPPARAM
  # - BPPARAM: BiocParallel parameter object
  # - verbose: logical; print progress messages
  #
  # Returns a list (class prewhiten_all_result):
  # - dt_whitened: data.table with whitened columns appended
  # - diagnostics: data.table with per-variable summary and aggregated block diagnostics in list-column
  # - cov_list: named list of assembled covariances (when requested; NULL entries possible)
  # - sparse_obj: the supplied sparse_obj (unchanged)
  #
  # Requirements: data.table, Matrix, BiocParallel (only if parallel = TRUE)

  if (!requireNamespace("data.table", quietly = TRUE)) stop("data.table required")
  if (!is.list(sparse_obj) || !"full_block_covs" %in% names(sparse_obj) || !"index_map" %in% names(sparse_obj)) {
    stop("sparse_obj must be a list with elements 'full_block_covs' and 'index_map'")
  }
  if (!inherits(dt_sub, "data.table")) dt_sub <- data.table::as.data.table(dt_sub)
  stopifnot(is.character(vars))
  if (!all(vars %in% names(dt_sub))) stop("Some vars are not columns of dt_sub")

  # prepare outputs
  dt_out <- data.table::copy(dt_sub)
  cov_list <- vector("list", length(vars)); names(cov_list) <- vars

  diagnostics_rows <- vector("list", length(vars))  # will hold per-variable summary rows
  block_diag_list <- vector("list", length(vars))   # will hold per-variable block diagnostics (list-column)

  # wrapper to whiten a single variable; returns list(var, whitened, diag_dt, cov_built, cov)
  whiten_one <- function(varname) {
    if (verbose) message("prewhiten_all_variables: processing ", varname)
    res <- list(var = varname, whitened = rep(NA_real_, nrow(dt_sub)), diag = NULL, cov_built = FALSE, cov = NULL)

    # call prewhiten_variable_blockwise (expected to return list(whitened, diagnostics))
    pw <- tryCatch({
      prewhiten_variable_blockwise(varname = varname, dt_sub = dt_sub, sparse_obj = sparse_obj, verbose = verbose)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("prewhiten_variable_blockwise failed for ", varname, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    })

    if (is.null(pw)) {
      # preserve NA vector and a one-row diagnostic indicating failure
      res$diag <- data.table::data.table(key = NA_character_, n_cov = NA_integer_, n_map = 0L, used = FALSE, reason = "prewhiten_failed")
      return(res)
    }

    # pw should be list(whitened = numeric vector, diagnostics = data.table)
    if (!is.null(pw$whitened) && length(pw$whitened) == nrow(dt_sub)) {
      res$whitened <- pw$whitened
    } else {
      warning("prewhiten_variable_blockwise returned unexpected whitened length for ", varname)
      # keep NA vector
    }

    # diagnostics: ensure data.table
    if (!is.null(pw$diagnostics)) {
      res$diag <- data.table::as.data.table(pw$diagnostics)
    } else {
      res$diag <- data.table::data.table(key = NA_character_, n_cov = NA_integer_, n_map = 0L, used = FALSE, reason = "no_diag")
    }

    # assemble global block-diagonal covariance if requested
    if (isTRUE(assemble_cov)) {
      if (!is.function(cov_assembler)) {
        warning("assemble_cov = TRUE but cov_assembler is not a function; skipping covariance assembly for ", varname)
        res$cov_built <- FALSE
        res$cov <- NULL
      } else {
        cov_mat <- tryCatch({
          cov_assembler(sparse_obj$full_block_covs, varname)
        }, error = function(e) {
          warning("cov_assembler failed for ", varname, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL
        })
        res$cov <- cov_mat
        res$cov_built <- !is.null(cov_mat)
      }
    } else {
      res$cov_built <- FALSE
      res$cov <- NULL
    }

    res
  }

  # run either serially or in parallel
  if (isTRUE(parallel)) {
    if (!requireNamespace("BiocParallel", quietly = TRUE)) stop("BiocParallel required for parallel = TRUE")
    res_list <- BiocParallel::bplapply(vars, whiten_one, BPPARAM = BPPARAM)
  } else {
    res_list <- lapply(vars, whiten_one)
  }

  # attach whitened columns and collect diagnostics
  for (i in seq_along(res_list)) {
    r <- res_list[[i]]
    var <- r$var
    wcol <- paste0(var, whiten_suffix)

    # whitened may be nested list (compatibility); extract vector
    wvec <- r$whitened
    if (is.list(wvec) && "whitened" %in% names(wvec)) wvec <- wvec$whitened
    if (!is.numeric(wvec) || length(wvec) != nrow(dt_sub)) {
      # ensure correct length with NAs to avoid recycling mistakes
      warning("Whitened vector for ", var, " has wrong length; filling with NA")
      wvec <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(dt_sub))
    }

    dt_out[, (wcol) := wvec]

    # per-variable summary
    n_obs <- sum(!is.na(dt_sub[[var]]))
    n_whitened <- sum(!is.na(wvec))
    prop_na <- mean(is.na(wvec))
    cov_built <- isTRUE(r$cov_built)
    diagnostics_rows[[i]] <- data.table::data.table(variable = var, n_obs = n_obs, n_whitened = n_whitened, prop_na = prop_na, cov_built = cov_built)

    # block diagnostics list-column (store raw table or NULL)
    block_diag_list[[i]] <- if (!is.null(r$diag)) r$diag else data.table::data.table()

    # store assembled covariance if present
    cov_list[[var]] <- r$cov
  }

  diagnostics_dt <- data.table::rbindlist(diagnostics_rows, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  diagnostics_dt[, timestamp := Sys.time()]

  # attach block-level diagnostics as a list-column (parallel index order corresponds to vars)
  diagnostics_dt[, block_diag := block_diag_list]

  out <- list(
    dt_whitened = dt_out,
    diagnostics = diagnostics_dt,
    cov_list = cov_list,
    sparse_obj = sparse_obj
  )
  class(out) <- c("prewhiten_all_result", class(out))
  out
}

# For variable 'v', assemble block-diagonal covariance across all chromosomes in decay_dt
assemble_cov_for_variable <- function(full_block_covs, decay_dt, varname) {
  keys <- names(full_block_covs)[grepl(paste0(":::", varname, "$"), names(full_block_covs))]
  mats <- lapply(keys, function(k) full_block_covs[[k]])
  if (length(mats) == 0) return(NULL)
  # blockDiag from Matrix
  do.call(bdiag, mats)
}

# Suppose windows are ordered and same row_id order for all variables.
# vars_order is c("avg_pi","B","avg_mut")
# index_map ties row positions to original rows.
build_full_sample_cov_for_lavaan <- function(dt, vars_order, full_block_covs, index_map) {
  # number of windows
  n_windows <- nrow(dt)
  p <- length(vars_order)
  # Full covariance is (p * n) x (p * n) if you stack variables per window; usually too big.
  # Instead compute covariance across variables (p x p) using aggregated summaries:
  # Option A: compute covariance of window-wise averages (collapsed to sample of windows).
  window_mat <- as.matrix(dt[, ..vars_order])
  sample_cov_vars <- cov(window_mat, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  list(sample_cov_vars = sample_cov_vars, n_obs = nrow(window_mat))
}

# Helper wrapper for plotting diagnostics (optional)
plot_decay_diagnostics <- function(binned, alpha = NA_real_, sigma2 = NA_real_, chr_label = NULL) {
  if (is.null(binned) || nrow(binned) == 0) stop("No binned data to plot")
  ggplot(binned, aes(x = dmed, y = cov_trim)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line() +
    labs(x = "Distance (bp)", y = "Binned covariance (trimmed mean)", title = paste0("Empirical binned covariance", if (!is.null(chr_label)) paste0(" - chrom ", chr_label) else "")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    {if (!is.na(alpha) && !is.na(sigma2)) {
      stat_function(fun = function(x) sigma2 * exp(-alpha * x), color = "steelblue", size = 1)
    } else NULL}
}

rebuild_index_map_from_block_map <- function(sparse_obj,
                                             block_map_sub,
                                             dt_sub,
                                             by_chr = "chrom",
                                             block_id_col = "block_id",
                                             orig_row_col = "row_id",
                                             midpoint_col = "midpoint",
                                             key_fun = function(chr, bid, var = NULL) paste0(chr, "_", bid),
                                             verbose = TRUE) {
  if (!requireNamespace("data.table", quietly = TRUE)) stop("data.table required")
  block_map_sub <- data.table::as.data.table(block_map_sub)
  dt_sub <- data.table::as.data.table(dt_sub)

  stopifnot(all(c(by_chr, block_id_col, orig_row_col) %in% names(block_map_sub)))
  stopifnot(midpoint_col %in% names(dt_sub))

  # Ensure integer orig rows
  block_map_sub[[orig_row_col]] <- as.integer(block_map_sub[[orig_row_col]])
  block_map_sub[[by_chr]] <- as.character(block_map_sub[[by_chr]])

  # Keep only valid orig_row indices
  block_map_sub <- block_map_sub[!is.na(get(orig_row_col)) & get(orig_row_col) >= 1 & get(orig_row_col) <= nrow(dt_sub)]
  if (nrow(block_map_sub) == 0L) stop("block_map_sub contains no valid orig_row indices")

  # Produce per-block canonical ordered lists
  # Ensure dt_sub has midpoint and is numeric
  dt_sub[[midpoint_col]] <- as.numeric(dt_sub[[midpoint_col]])

  # We'll create a table of unique block rows, then attach midpoints and order
  bm <- unique(block_map_sub[, .(chrom = get(by_chr), block_id = get(block_id_col), orig_row = get(orig_row_col))])

  # attach midpoint for ordering
  bm[, midpoint := dt_sub[orig_row, get(midpoint_col)]]
  data.table::setorder(bm, chrom, block_id, midpoint)

  # build index_map rows
  index_map_rows <- bm[, .(key = key_fun(chrom, block_id, NA), chrom = chrom, block_id = block_id, row_id = as.integer(orig_row)), by = .I]
  # compute idx within each key (block)
  index_map_rows[, idx := seq_len(.N), by = .(key)]
  index_map <- index_map_rows[, .(key, chrom, block_id, row_id, idx)]

  # attach optional variable column if sparse_obj$diagnostics provides it
  if (!is.null(sparse_obj$diagnostics) && "variable" %in% names(sparse_obj$diagnostics)) {
    # try to infer variable per key from diagnostics (best-effort)
    var_dt <- unique(sparse_obj$diagnostics[, c("chr","variable"), drop = FALSE])
    # if diagnostics don't match, fill with NA
    index_map[, variable := NA_character_]
  } else {
    index_map[, variable := NA_character_]
  }

  # attach to sparse_obj (copy not to modify original unexpectedly)
  sparse_obj$index_map <- index_map

  # basic sanity print
  if (verbose) {
    message("Rebuilt index_map with ", nrow(index_map), " rows across ", length(unique(index_map$key)), " keys")
    example_keys <- head(unique(index_map$key), 6)
    message("Example keys: ", paste(example_keys, collapse = ", "))
  }

  sparse_obj
}

# so that midpoints are unique
add_genome_offsets_and_midpoint <- function(table_10kb,
                                            chrom_lengths = NULL,
                                            chrom_col = "chrom",
                                            start_col = "chromStart",
                                            end_col = "chromEnd",
                                            out_midpoint_name = "midpoint",
                                            order_chrom_by = c("natural", "provided", "lexicographic"),
                                            keep_integer_midpoint = FALSE) {
  # Purpose
  # - Compute per-chromosome cumulative offsets and genome-wide coordinates (gstart/gend)
  # - Compute genome-wide midpoint (numeric or integer)
  # - Ensure chromosome "first" (by chosen ordering) receives offset 0 (no added offset)
  #
  # Expectations
  # - table_10kb contains columns named chrom_col, start_col, end_col (defaults: chrom, chromStart, chromEnd)
  # - Returns a copy of table_10kb with added columns:
  #     chrom_offset (numeric), gstart (numeric), gend (numeric), <out_midpoint_name> (numeric or integer)
  #
  # Notes
  # - Uses numeric coordinates to avoid 32-bit integer overflow for large genomes
  # - If keep_integer_midpoint = TRUE midpoint is rounded to integer via floor()
  #
  if (!requireNamespace("data.table", quietly = TRUE)) stop("data.table required")
  order_chrom_by <- match.arg(order_chrom_by)

  dt <- data.table::as.data.table(table_10kb)

  # validate input columns
  if (!all(c(chrom_col, start_col, end_col) %in% names(dt))) {
    stop("table_10kb must contain columns: ", paste(c(chrom_col, start_col, end_col), collapse = ", "))
  }

  # normalize types
  dt[[chrom_col]] <- as.character(dt[[chrom_col]])
  dt[[start_col]] <- as.numeric(dt[[start_col]])
  dt[[end_col]] <- as.numeric(dt[[end_col]])

  # build chrom_lengths if not supplied
  if (is.null(chrom_lengths)) {
    chrom_lengths <- dt[, .(length = max(get(end_col), na.rm = TRUE)), by = chrom_col]
    data.table::setnames(chrom_lengths, old = chrom_col, new = "chrom", skip_absent = TRUE)
  } else {
    chrom_lengths <- data.table::as.data.table(chrom_lengths)
    # normalize expected column names
    if (!("chrom" %in% names(chrom_lengths))) {
      if (chrom_col %in% names(chrom_lengths)) data.table::setnames(chrom_lengths, chrom_col, "chrom")
    }
    if (!("length" %in% names(chrom_lengths))) {
      if ("chromEnd" %in% names(chrom_lengths)) data.table::setnames(chrom_lengths, "chromEnd", "length")
      else if ("end" %in% names(chrom_lengths)) data.table::setnames(chrom_lengths, "end", "length")
      else stop("chrom_lengths must provide columns: chrom and length (or chromEnd/end)")
    }
    chrom_lengths[, chrom := as.character(chrom)]
    chrom_lengths[, length := as.numeric(length)]
  }

  # determine chromosome order
  chroms <- unique(chrom_lengths$chrom)
  if (order_chrom_by == "provided") {
    chrom_lengths <- chrom_lengths[match(chroms, chrom_lengths$chrom)]
  } else if (order_chrom_by == "natural") {
    extract_num <- function(x) {
      x2 <- sub("^chr", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
      suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("^.*?_?([0-9]+)$", "\\1", x2)))
    }
    nums <- extract_num(chroms)
    has_num <- !is.na(nums)
    # numeric chromosomes first sorted, then the remainder lexicographically
    ord <- c(order(nums[has_num], na.last = NA), order(chroms[!has_num]))
    chrom_ordered <- chroms[ord]
    chrom_lengths <- chrom_lengths[match(chrom_ordered, chrom_lengths$chrom)]
  } else {
    chrom_lengths <- chrom_lengths[order(chrom)]
  }

  # compute cumulative offsets such that the first chromosome has offset 0
  chrom_lengths[, chrom_offset := as.numeric(data.table::shift(cumsum(length), fill = 0))]

  # join offsets into dt
  setkeyv(chrom_lengths, "chrom")
  dt_temp <- copy(dt)
  data.table::setnames(dt_temp, old = chrom_col, new = "chrom", skip_absent = TRUE)
  dt_temp <- chrom_lengths[dt_temp, on = .(chrom)]

  # compute genome-wide coordinates; first chromosome receives offset 0 by design
  dt_temp[, gstart := chrom_offset + get(start_col)]
  dt_temp[, gend   := chrom_offset + get(end_col)]
  dt_temp[, (out_midpoint_name) := (gstart + gend) / 2]

  if (isTRUE(keep_integer_midpoint)) {
    dt_temp[, (out_midpoint_name) := floor(get(out_midpoint_name))]
  }

  # restore original chrom column name if different
  if (chrom_col != "chrom") data.table::setnames(dt_temp, "chrom", chrom_col)

  # assemble output columns (preserve original columns order then append new columns)
  new_cols <- c("chrom_offset", "gstart", "gend", out_midpoint_name)
  # avoid duplicating columns if input already had same names
  new_cols <- new_cols[!new_cols %in% names(table_10kb)]
  out_cols <- c(names(table_10kb), new_cols)
  out <- dt_temp[, ..out_cols]
  return(out[])
}

whitened_diagnostics <- function(target_var,
                                 sel_chrs = sort(unique(dt_sub$chrom)),
                                 predictors,
                                 dt_raw = dt_sub,
                                 dt_wh = dt_whitened,
                                 max_lag = 50) {

  whitened_col <- paste0(target_var, "_wh")
  out <- vector("list", length(sel_chrs))
  names(out) <- as.character(sel_chrs)

  for (i in seq_along(sel_chrs)) {
    chr_val <- sel_chrs[i]
    dr <- dt_raw[chrom == chr_val]
    dw <- dt_wh[chrom == chr_val]

    # raw OLS
    res_raw <- tryCatch({
      fml_r <- as.formula(paste(target_var, "~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))
      fit_r <- lm(fml_r, data = dr)
      resid_r <- resid(fit_r)
      list(n_raw = nrow(dr),
           n_non_na_raw = sum(!is.na(dr[[target_var]])),
           resid_sd_raw = if (length(resid_r) > 0) sd(resid_r, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
           acf_ok_raw = length(na.omit(resid_r)) >= 3)
    }, error = function(e) {
      list(n_raw = nrow(dr),
           n_non_na_raw = sum(!is.na(dr[[target_var]])),
           resid_sd_raw = NA_real_,
           acf_ok_raw = FALSE,
           raw_error = conditionMessage(e))
    })

    # whitened OLS (if possible)
    if (!is.null(dw) && whitened_col %in% names(dw) && nrow(dw) > 0) {
      res_wh <- tryCatch({
        # create a temporary merged table if predictors missing in dw
        if (!all(predictors %in% names(dw))) {
          if ("midpoint" %in% names(dr) && "midpoint" %in% names(dw)) {
            merged <- merge(dr[, .(chrom, midpoint, .SD), .SDcols = predictors],
                            dw[, .(chrom, midpoint, whitened = get(whitened_col))],
                            by = c("chrom", "midpoint"), all = FALSE)
            fml_w <- as.formula(paste("whitened ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))
            fit_w <- lm(fml_w, data = merged)
            resid_w <- resid(fit_w)
            list(n_wh = nrow(dw),
                 n_non_na_wh = sum(!is.na(dw[[whitened_col]])),
                 resid_sd_wh = if (length(resid_w) > 0) sd(resid_w, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
                 acf_ok_wh = length(na.omit(resid_w)) >= 3,
                 merged_rows = nrow(merged))
          } else {
            list(n_wh = nrow(dw),
                 n_non_na_wh = sum(!is.na(dw[[whitened_col]])),
                 resid_sd_wh = NA_real_,
                 acf_ok_wh = FALSE,
                 merged_rows = 0,
                 wh_error = "predictors missing in dt_whitened and cannot merge")
          }
        } else {
          dw2 <- copy(dw)
          dw2[, whitened := dw2[[whitened_col]]]
          fml_w <- as.formula(paste("whitened ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))
          fit_w <- lm(fml_w, data = dw2)
          resid_w <- resid(fit_w)
          list(n_wh = nrow(dw),
               n_non_na_wh = sum(!is.na(dw[[whitened_col]])),
               resid_sd_wh = if (length(resid_w) > 0) sd(resid_w, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
               acf_ok_wh = length(na.omit(resid_w)) >= 3,
               merged_rows = NA_integer_)
        }
      }, error = function(e) {
        list(n_wh = nrow(dw),
             n_non_na_wh = sum(!is.na(dw[[whitened_col]])),
             resid_sd_wh = NA_real_,
             acf_ok_wh = FALSE,
             wh_error = conditionMessage(e))
      })
    } else {
      res_wh <- list(n_wh = if (!is.null(dw)) nrow(dw) else 0,
                     n_non_na_wh = if (!is.null(dw) && whitened_col %in% names(dw)) sum(!is.na(dw[[whitened_col]])) else 0,
                     resid_sd_wh = NA_real_,
                     acf_ok_wh = FALSE,
                     merged_rows = 0,
                     wh_error = "whitened column missing or no whitened rows")
    }

    out[[i]] <- c(chr = chr_val, res_raw, res_wh)
    message("chr ", chr_val, " | raw rows=", res_raw$n_raw, " raw non-NA=", res_raw$n_non_na_raw,
            " | wh rows=", res_wh$n_wh, " wh non-NA=", res_wh$n_non_na_wh)
  }

  dt_out <- rbindlist(lapply(out, as.data.table), fill = TRUE)
  numcols <- setdiff(names(dt_out), "chr")
  for (nc in numcols) dt_out[[nc]] <- as.numeric(dt_out[[nc]])
  setnames(dt_out, "chr", "chrom")
  dt_out[]
}
# --- end function ---
```

Automated pipeline

```{r SEM-helpers-2, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

make_sparse_cov_blocks <- function(block_map,
                                   decay_dt,
                                   dt,
                                   by_chr = "chrom",
                                   block_id_col = "block_id",
                                   orig_row_col = "orig_row",
                                   midpoint_col = "midpoint",
                                   variable_col = "variable",
                                   max_pair_distance = 2e5,
                                   tol_sym = 1e-9,
                                   key_fun = NULL,
                                   chunk_threshold = 3000L,
                                   verbose = FALSE) {
  # dependencies
  if (!requireNamespace("data.table", quietly = TRUE)) stop("data.table required")
  if (!requireNamespace("Matrix", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Matrix required")
  data.table <- data.table::as.data.table

  # input validation & copies
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(block_map) || data.table::is.data.table(block_map))
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(decay_dt) || data.table::is.data.table(decay_dt))
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(dt) || data.table::is.data.table(dt))
  block_map <- data.table::as.data.table(block_map)
  decay_dt  <- data.table::as.data.table(decay_dt)
  dt        <- data.table::as.data.table(dt)

  stopifnot(by_chr %in% names(block_map))
  stopifnot(orig_row_col %in% names(block_map))
  stopifnot(midpoint_col %in% names(dt))
  block_map[[by_chr]] <- as.character(block_map[[by_chr]])
  dt[[by_chr]] <- as.character(dt[[by_chr]])
  block_map[[orig_row_col]] <- as.integer(block_map[[orig_row_col]])

  # default key builder
  if (is.null(key_fun)) key_fun <- function(chr, bid, var = NULL) paste0(chr, "_", bid)

  full_block_covs <- list()
  diagnostics <- list()
  hiccups <- list()
  index_map_rows <- list()
  imr_i <- 0L

  # iterate unique (chr, block_id)
  uniq_blocks <- unique(block_map[, .(block_id = get(block_id_col), chr = get(by_chr))])
  setorder(uniq_blocks, chr, block_id)

  for (r in seq_len(nrow(uniq_blocks))) {
    chr_val <- uniq_blocks$chr[r]
    bid <- uniq_blocks$block_id[r]

    rows_block <- block_map[get(block_id_col) == bid & get(by_chr) == chr_val]
    if (nrow(rows_block) == 0L) next

    # orig_row indices into dt
    orig_rows <- unique(na.omit(as.integer(rows_block[[orig_row_col]])))
    # keep only valid row indices
    orig_rows <- orig_rows[orig_rows >= 1 & orig_rows <= nrow(dt)]
    if (length(orig_rows) < 1L) next

    dt_block <- dt[orig_rows]
    n_windows <- nrow(dt_block)
    if (n_windows < 1L) next

    # choose variable to look up decay: prefer variable_col in decay_dt for this chr
    decay_row <- decay_dt[get(by_chr) == chr_val]
    if (nrow(decay_row) == 0L) {
      hiccups[[length(hiccups)+1L]] <- list(key = paste0(chr_val, "_", bid), reason = "no_decay_info")
      next
    }
    # pick first matching variable that exists in dt_block, or the first row's variable
    vars_candidates <- unique(as.character(decay_row[[variable_col]]))
    varname <- NULL
    for (v in vars_candidates) if (!is.null(v) && v %in% names(dt_block)) { varname <- v; break }
    if (is.null(varname)) varname <- as.character(decay_row[[variable_col]][1])

    # get decay params
    decay_params <- decay_dt[get(by_chr) == chr_val & get(variable_col) == varname]
    if (nrow(decay_params) == 0L) {
      # fallback: try same chr any variable
      decay_params <- decay_dt[get(by_chr) == chr_val][1]
    }
    if (nrow(decay_params) == 0L) { hiccups[[length(hiccups)+1L]] <- list(key = paste0(chr_val, "_", bid), reason = "decay_missing"); next }
    alpha <- as.numeric(decay_params$alpha[1]); sigma2 <- as.numeric(decay_params$sigma2[1])
    if (!is.finite(alpha) || alpha <= 0) alpha <- 1e-6
    if (!is.finite(sigma2) || sigma2 <= 0) sigma2 <- max(1e-12, var(dt_block[[varname]], na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)

    # positions and quick filter for within-distance pairs
    pos <- as.numeric(dt_block[[midpoint_col]])
    ord <- order(pos)
    pos <- pos[ord]
    orig_rows_ord <- orig_rows[ord]

    # Efficient pair generation limited by max_pair_distance:
    # For each i, find j indices with pos[j] - pos[i] <= max_pair_distance
    i_list <- integer(0); j_list <- integer(0); vals <- numeric(0)
    # Chunk approach for large blocks to avoid huge temporary storage
    if (n_windows <= chunk_threshold) {
      for (i in seq_len(n_windows - 1L)) {
        # find max j where distance <= threshold
        jmax <- findInterval(pos[i] + max_pair_distance, pos)
        if (jmax > i) {
          js <- (i + 1L):jmax
          i_list <- c(i_list, rep(i, length(js)))
          j_list <- c(j_list, js)
          # compute cov values on the fly
          vals <- c(vals, sigma2 * exp(-alpha * (pos[js] - pos[i])))
        }
      }
    } else {
      # chunk i ranges to limit memory
      chunk_size <- chunk_threshold
      for (start in seq(1L, n_windows - 1L, by = chunk_size)) {
        end <- min(n_windows - 1L, start + chunk_size - 1L)
        for (i in start:end) {
          jmax <- findInterval(pos[i] + max_pair_distance, pos)
          if (jmax > i) {
            js <- (i + 1L):jmax
            i_list <- c(i_list, rep(i, length(js)))
            j_list <- c(j_list, js)
            vals <- c(vals, sigma2 * exp(-alpha * (pos[js] - pos[i])))
          }
        }
        # keep vectors from growing too large in memory by periodically converting to sparse matrix partials
        if (length(i_list) > 1e6) break
      }
      # if we broke early because of memory, fall back to a sampled approach
      if (length(i_list) > 1e6) {
        # uniform sample of pairs to represent block (memory-bound fallback)
        sample_idx <- sample(seq_along(i_list), size = min(1e6, length(i_list)))
        i_list <- i_list[sample_idx]; j_list <- j_list[sample_idx]; vals <- vals[sample_idx]
        if (verbose) message("Block large; used sampled pair set for block ", chr_val, "_", bid)
      }
    }

    if (length(i_list) == 0L) {
      # no within-distance pairs: produce diagonal-only covariance
      cov_mat <- Matrix::Diagonal(n = n_windows, x = rep(sigma2, n_windows))
      cov_mat <- as(cov_mat, "dsCMatrix")
    } else {
      # assemble sparse symmetric covariance matrix from triplet list
      # create i,j in 1..n_windows
      ii <- i_list; jj <- j_list; vv <- vals
      # include symmetric entries
      ii2 <- c(ii, jj, seq_len(n_windows))
      jj2 <- c(jj, ii, seq_len(n_windows))
      vv2 <- c(vv, vv, rep(sigma2, n_windows))
      sp <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(i = ii2, j = jj2, x = vv2, dims = c(n_windows, n_windows), symmetric = FALSE)
      # symmetrize robustly and convert to dsCMatrix
      sp <- (sp + Matrix::t(sp)) / 2
      cov_mat <- as(sp, "dsCMatrix")
    }

    # final sanity (jitter diag if needed)
    diag_vals <- diag(cov_mat)
    diag_vals[diag_vals <= 0 | !is.finite(diag_vals)] <- max(1e-12, sigma2)
    diag(cov_mat) <- diag_vals

    # store using canonical key
    key <- key_fun(chr_val, bid, varname)
    full_block_covs[[key]] <- cov_mat

    # append index_map rows (preserve ordering used above: orig_rows_ord)
    for (k in seq_along(orig_rows_ord)) {
      imr_i <- imr_i + 1L
      index_map_rows[[imr_i]] <- list(key = key,
                                      chrom = chr_val,
                                      block_id = bid,
                                      variable = varname,
                                      row_id = as.integer(orig_rows_ord[k]),
                                      idx = as.integer(k))
    }

    # diagnostics
    diagnostics[[key]] <- list(chr = chr_val,
                               block_id = bid,
                               n_windows = n_windows,
                               alpha = alpha,
                               sigma2 = sigma2,
                               method = as.character(decay_params$method[1] %||% NA_character_),
                               fallback = as.character(decay_params$fallback_reasons[1] %||% NA_character_),
                               nnz = length(cov_mat@x),
                               dims = dim(cov_mat))
    if (verbose && (r %% 100 == 0 || r == nrow(uniq_blocks))) message("Processed block ", r, "/", nrow(uniq_blocks), " key=", key)
  } # end blocks loop

  # assemble index_map and diagnostics tables
  if (length(index_map_rows) > 0L) {
    index_map <- data.table::rbindlist(index_map_rows, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
  } else {
    index_map <- data.table::data.table(key = character(0), chrom = character(0), block_id = integer(0), variable = character(0), row_id = integer(0), idx = integer(0))
  }
  diagnostics_dt <- if (length(diagnostics) > 0L) data.table::rbindlist(lapply(diagnostics, as.data.table), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE) else data.table::data.table()
  hiccup_dt <- if (length(hiccups) > 0L) data.table::rbindlist(lapply(hiccups, as.data.table), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE) else data.table::data.table()

  out <- list(
    full_block_covs = full_block_covs,
    index_map = index_map,
    diagnostics = diagnostics_dt,
    hiccups = hiccup_dt,
    params = list(by_chr = by_chr, block_id_col = block_id_col, orig_row_col = orig_row_col, midpoint_col = midpoint_col, max_pair_distance = max_pair_distance)
  )
  class(out) <- c("sparse_cov_blocks", class(out))
  out
}
```

Helper function to construct lavaan model strings

```{r make-lavaan-models, eval=T, include=T}

make_lavaan_model <- function(edges,
                              covs = NULL,
                              defined = NULL,
                              groups = NULL,
                              free_by = c("shared", "groups", "named"),
                              per_group_map = NULL,
                              label_prefix = "p",
                              sep = "  ") {
  free_by <- match.arg(free_by)
  stopifnot(is.list(edges) && length(edges) > 0)

  # helper to normalize an RHS spec into a list(predictor, label, start)
  normalize_rhs <- function(r) {
    if (is.character(r) && length(r) == 1) return(list(p = r, label = NULL, start = NULL))
    if (is.list(r) && !is.null(r$p)) {
      return(list(p = as.character(r$p),
                  label = if (!is.null(r$label)) as.character(r$label) else NULL,
                  start = if (!is.null(r$start)) as.numeric(r$start) else NULL))
    }
    stop("RHS must be a string or list with element 'p'")
  }

  # build lines
  lines <- character(0)
  for (lhs in names(edges)) {
    rhss <- edges[[lhs]]
    for (r in rhss) {
      nr <- normalize_rhs(r)
      p <- nr$p; lab <- nr$label; st <- nr$start

      if (free_by == "shared") {
        # use provided label if present, otherwise leave unlabeled (group-free)
        if (!is.null(lab)) {
          lab_part <- paste0(lab, "*")
        } else {
          lab_part <- ""
        }
        start_part <- if (!is.null(st)) paste0("start(", st, ")*") else ""
        line <- paste0(lhs, " ~ ", start_part, lab_part, p)
        lines <- c(lines, line)
      } else if (free_by == "groups") {
        if (is.null(groups) || groups < 1) stop("groups must be provided for free_by='groups'")
        # generate a vector label with length == groups, e.g., c(x1,x2,...)
        lab_names <- paste0(label_prefix, seq_len(groups))
        lab_vec <- paste0("c(", paste(lab_names, collapse = ", "), ")*")
        start_part <- if (!is.null(st)) paste0("start(", st, ")*") else ""
        line <- paste0(lhs, " ~ ", start_part, lab_vec, p)
        lines <- c(lines, line)
      } else { # free_by == "named"
        # per_group_map is a named character vector e.g., c("avg_pi~avg_mut" = "groups")
        key <- paste0(lhs, "~", p)
        if (!is.null(per_group_map) && !is.na(per_group_map[key]) && per_group_map[key] == "groups") {
          if (is.null(groups)) stop("groups must be provided for per-group labels")
          lab_names <- paste0(label_prefix, seq_len(groups))
          lab_vec <- paste0("c(", paste(lab_names, collapse = ", "), ")*")
          start_part <- if (!is.null(st)) paste0("start(", st, ")*") else ""
          line <- paste0(lhs, " ~ ", start_part, lab_vec, p)
        } else {
          # shared or unlabeled
          if (!is.null(lab)) lab_part <- paste0(lab, "*") else lab_part <- ""
          start_part <- if (!is.null(st)) paste0("start(", st, ")*") else ""
          line <- paste0(lhs, " ~ ", start_part, lab_part, p)
        }
        lines <- c(lines, line)
      }
    }
  }

  # covariances
  if (!is.null(covs) && length(covs) > 0) {
    for (cv in covs) {
      # cv may be c("a","b") or list(c("a","b"))
      if (is.character(cv) && length(cv) == 2) {
        lines <- c(lines, paste0(cv[1], " ~~ ", cv[2]))
      } else if (is.list(cv) && length(cv) == 2) {
        lines <- c(lines, paste0(cv[[1]], " ~~ ", cv[[2]]))
      } else {
        stop("covs must be pairs of variable names")
      }
    }
  }

  # defined parameters
  if (!is.null(defined) && length(defined) > 0) {
    for (nm in names(defined)) {
      lines <- c(lines, paste0(nm, " := ", defined[[nm]]))
    }
  }

  paste(lines, collapse = paste0("\n", sep))
}

# example usage
edges <- list(
  avg_pi = list(list(p="avg_mut", label="c1", start=0.25),
                list(p="B", label="c2", start=0.5),
                list(p="prop_del_sites", label="c3", start=-0.25)),
  B = list(list(p="prop_del_sites", label="c4", start=-0.25),
           list(p="avg_mut", label="c5", start=-0.25),
           list(p="avg_rec", label="c6", start=0.25)),
  avg_mut = list(list(p="avg_rec", label="c7", start=0.25))
)
covs <- list(c("avg_mut","prop_del_sites"))

defined <- c(mu_B_pi="c1*c5",
             rec_B_pi="c2*c6", 
             rec_mu_pi="c1*c7", 
             rec_mu_B_pi="c2*c5*c7")

model_shared <- make_lavaan_model(edges, 
                                  covs=covs, 
                                  defined=defined, 
                                  free_by="shared")
cat(model_shared)

model_groups <- make_lavaan_model(edges, 
                                  covs=covs, defined=defined,
                                  groups=22, 
                                  free_by="groups",
                                  label_prefix="x")
cat(model_groups)

per_group_map <- c("avg_pi~avg_mut"="groups", "avg_pi~B"="groups")
model_hybrid <- make_lavaan_model(edges, 
                                  covs=covs,
                                  defined=defined,
                                  groups=22, free_by="named",
                                  per_group_map=per_group_map,
                                  label_prefix="g")
cat(model_hybrid)
```

```{r, evaluate-whitening, eval=T, include=T}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. Configuration
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
sel_chrs <- c(2L, 8L, 22L)
window_bp <- 1e4
max_block_span <- 1e6

  avg_pi = c("B", "avg_mut", "avg_rec")
)

# 1. Subset data
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

tbl_10kb$avg_pi <- log(tbl_10kb$avg_pi)

# because of 0's
if(any(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites==0)) {
  tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites <- log1p(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites) 
} else {
  tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites <- log(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites) 
}

         dplyr::select(., -constrained_model)

                                            "chromStart", 
                                            "chromEnd"))

                                                      "chromStart", 
                                                      "chromEnd"))

tbl_10kb <- left_join(tbl_10kb, mut_latent_10kb, by=c("chrom", 
                                                      "chromStart", 
                                                      "chromEnd"))

tbl_10kb <- filter(tbl_10kb, coverage >= 0.75)
names(tbl_10kb)[8:10] <- c("B", "avg_rec", "avg_mut")

dt <- copy(tbl_10kb) %>%
       mutate(midpoint=(chromStart + chromEnd) / 2) %>%
       arrange(chrom, midpoint) %>%
       as.data.table()
setDT(dt)

stopifnot(all(c("chrom", "midpoint", target_var, vars_list[[target_var]]) %in% names(dt)))
dt_sub <- dt[chrom %in% sel_chrs]
setorderv(dt_sub, c("chrom", "midpoint"))
message("Windows after subset: ", nrow(dt_sub), " (chrom: ", paste(unique(dt_sub$chrom), collapse = ", "), ")")

# Run block specs
specs <- make_block_specs_robust(dt_sub, 
                                 vars = vars_list, 
                                 by_chr = "chrom", 
                                 window_bp = window_bp, 
                                 max_block_span = max_block_span)
block_map <- specs$block_map
decay_dt <- specs$decay_dt
message("Decay estimates produced for ", nrow(decay_dt), " chr-variable combos.")

# Print decay summary for target variable
print(decay_dt[variable == target_var])

for(chr in c("2","8","22")) {
  row <- decay_dt[chrom == chr & variable == target_var]
  b <- row$binned[[1]]
  if (!is.null(b) && nrow(b) > 0) {
    plot(b$dmed, b$cov_trim, pch = 20, xlab = "distance", ylab = "binned cov", main = paste("chr", chr))
    curve(row$sigma2 * exp(-row$alpha * x), add = TRUE, col = "steelblue", lwd = 2)
  }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Build sparse covariance blocks
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
sparse_obj <- make_sparse_cov_blocks(
  block_map = block_map,
  decay_dt = decay_dt,
  dt = dt_sub,
  by_chr = "chrom",
  max_pair_distance = 2e5,
  verbose = TRUE
)
message("Built sparse block covariance objects: ", length(sparse_obj$full_block_covs), " blocks.")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Prewhiten target variable (avg_pi) using prewhiten_all_variables wrapper
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ensure prewhiten_all_variables is available (the wrapper you provided)
res_pw <- prewhiten_all_variables(dt_sub = dt_sub,
                                  vars = c(target_var),
                                  sparse_obj = sparse_obj,
                                  whiten_suffix = "_wh",
                                  assemble_cov = FALSE,
                                  parallel = FALSE,
                                  verbose = TRUE)
dt_whitened <- res_pw$dt_whitened
print(res_pw$diagnostics)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. For each chromosome: fit OLS, compute residuals raw and whitened, compute ACFs
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
compute_resid_and_acf <- function(dt_chr,
                                 response,
                                 predictors,
                                 whitened_col = NULL,
                                 max_lag = 50) {
  # build formula for raw data
  fml_raw <- as.formula(paste(response, "~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))
  ols_raw <- try(lm(fml_raw, data = dt_chr), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(ols_raw, "try-error")) return(NULL)

  resid_raw <- resid(ols_raw)
  acf_raw <- if (length(resid_raw) >= 3) {
    acf_obj <- acf(resid_raw, plot = FALSE, lag.max = max_lag, na.action = na.pass)
    data.table(lag = as.integer(acf_obj$lag[,1,1]), acf = as.numeric(acf_obj$acf[,1,1]))
  } else data.table(lag = integer(0), acf = numeric(0))

  # whitened branch: only run if whitened_col provided and present
  if (!is.null(whitened_col) && whitened_col %in% names(dt_chr)) {
    dt_chr2 <- copy(dt_chr)
    # place whitened response into a column named "response_wh"
    dt_chr2[, response_wh := dt_chr2[[whitened_col]]]
    fml_w <- as.formula(paste("response_wh ~", paste(predictors, collapse = " + ")))
    ols_w <- try(lm(fml_w, data = dt_chr2), silent = TRUE)

    if (inherits(ols_w, "try-error")) {
      resid_white <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(dt_chr2))
      acf_white <- data.table(lag = integer(0), acf = numeric(0))
    } else {
      resid_white <- resid(ols_w)
      acf_obj_w <- acf(resid_white, plot = FALSE, lag.max = max_lag, na.action = na.pass)
      acf_white <- data.table(lag = as.integer(acf_obj_w$lag[,1,1]), acf = as.numeric(acf_obj_w$acf[,1,1]))
    }
  } else {
    # whitened_col not provided or not present
    resid_white <- NULL
    acf_white <- data.table(lag = integer(0), acf = numeric(0))
  }

  list(acf_raw = acf_raw, acf_white = acf_white, resid_raw = resid_raw, resid_white = resid_white)
}

# Collection loop (robust to missing whitened rows)
acf_results <- list()
for (chr_val in sel_chrs) {
  dt_chr_raw <- dt_sub[chrom == chr_val]            # make sure column name is 'chrom'
  dt_chr_wh  <- dt_whitened[chrom == chr_val]       # same 'chrom' key expected
  whitened_col <- paste0(target_var, "_wh")         # e.g., "avg_pi_wh"
  res_chr <- compute_resid_and_acf(dt_chr_raw,
                                  response = target_var,
                                  predictors = vars_list[[target_var]],
                                  whitened_col = whitened_col,
                                  max_lag = 50)
  if (is.null(res_chr)) {
    message("chr ", chr_val, ": OLS failed; skipping")
    next
  }

  acf_raw <- res_chr$acf_raw
  if (nrow(acf_raw) > 0) acf_raw[, `:=`(chrom = chr_val, type = "raw")]

  acf_white <- res_chr$acf_white
  if (nrow(acf_white) > 0) acf_white[, `:=`(chrom = chr_val, type = "whitened")]

  acf_results[[as.character(chr_val)]] <- rbind(acf_raw, acf_white, fill = TRUE)
  message("chrom ", chr_val, ": raw acf rows = ", nrow(acf_raw), " ; whitened acf rows = ", nrow(acf_white))
}

# final combined table (may be empty for whitened rows)
acf_dt <- rbindlist(acf_results, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

table(is.na(dt_whitened[chrom == chr_val, ..whitened_col][[1]]))
```
