```{r, evaluate-whitening, eval=T, include=T}
# Single-chromosome diagnostics
target_var <- "avg_pi"   # set your response variable (no "_wh")
whitened_col <- paste0(target_var, "_wh")

# existence and row counts
cat("whitened column present:", whitened_col %in% names(dt_whitened), "\n")
cat("rows in dt_sub for chr", chr_val, ":", nrow(dt_sub[chrom == chr_val]), "\n")
cat("rows in dt_whitened for chr", chr_val, ":", nrow(dt_whitened[chrom == chr_val]), "\n")

# show first 10 values and NA summary for whitened col (if present)
if (whitened_col %in% names(dt_whitened)) {
  vals <- dt_whitened[chrom == chr_val, get(whitened_col)]
  print(head(vals, 10))
  print(summary(vals))
  cat("NA count:", sum(is.na(vals)), "non-NA count:", sum(!is.na(vals)), "\n")
  cat("sd (non-NA):", sd(vals, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
} else {
  cat("Whitened column not found in dt_whitened\n")
}

# quick check: are whitened rows matched to dt_sub by midpoint/chrom (if you expect same rows)
if ("midpoint" %in% names(dt_sub) && "midpoint" %in% names(dt_whitened)) {
  common <- merge(
    dt_sub[chrom == chr_val, .(chrom, midpoint, idx_sub = .I)],
    dt_whitened[chrom == chr_val, .(chrom, midpoint, idx_wh = .I)],
    by = c("chrom", "midpoint")
  )
  cat("matched rows by midpoint:", nrow(common), "\n")
  if (nrow(common) < nrow(dt_sub[chrom == chr_val])) {
    cat("Warning: some dt_sub rows not matched to dt_whitened for this chromosome\n")
  }
}

# set these to match your objects
target_var <- "avg_pi"
predictors <- c("B", "avg_mut", "prop_del_sites")
sel_chrs <- sort(unique(dt_sub$chrom))

diag_dt <- whitened_diagnostics(target_var = target_var,
                                sel_chrs = sel_chrs,
                                predictors = predictors,
                                dt_raw = dt_sub,
                                dt_wh  = dt_whitened)
# write a CSV for inspection
fwrite(diag_dt, file = file.path(path.expand("~/Desktop"), "whitened_diagnostics_by_chr.csv"))
print(diag_dt)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Plot ACFs side-by-side
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
p <- ggplot(acf_dt, aes(x = lag, y = acf, color = type)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ chrom, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(raw = "firebrick", whitened = "steelblue")) +
  labs(x = "Lag (index)", y = "ACF", color = "", title = paste0("Residual ACF for ", target_var, " before and after whitening")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +

print(p)

# 6. Numeric diagnostics: mean absolute ACF at lags 1:5 by chrom and type

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

for (chr_val in sel_chrs) {
  drow <- decay_dt[chrom == as.character(chr_val) & variable == target_var]
  if (nrow(drow) == 0) next
  method <- drow$method[1]

}
```

```{r, eval=F}
# Required libraries
library(data.table)
library(lavaan)
library(BiocParallel)

# Helpers --------------------------------------------------------------------

# null-coalesce
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (!is.null(x)) x else y

# Safe fwrite wrapper
safe_fwrite <- function(x, file, ...) {
  tryCatch({
    data.table::fwrite(x, file, ...)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("fwrite failed for ", file, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
  })
}

# Extract variable-like tokens from lavaan model text
extract_model_vars <- function(model_txt) {
  # matches variable names like my_var, my.var, myVar123, but excludes lavaan keywords
  toks <- unique(regmatches(model_txt, gregexpr("[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_\\.]*", model_txt))[[1]])
  # drop common lavaan keywords and operators
  drop <- c("~~", "~", "==", "~1", "NA", "ifelse")
  toks <- toks[!toks %in% drop]
  toks
}

# Validate that dt_whitened exists and is a data.table
validate_dt_whitened <- function(dt_whitened) {
  if (is.null(dt_whitened)) stop("dt_whitened not found. Run whitening pipeline before SEM runs.")
  if (!inherits(dt_whitened, "data.table")) dt_whitened <- as.data.table(dt_whitened)
  dt_whitened
}

# Build task list ------------------------------------------------------------

# Expect these objects to be defined in the calling environment:
# - scales: character/numeric vector of scales (bp)
# - model_texts: named list of lavaan model strings, names are model ids used in filenames
# - out_dir: directory to write outputs
# - dt_whitened: data.table with whitened columns named <var>_wh and a column "chrom"
# - BPPARAM: BiocParallel parameter object (e.g., MulticoreParam or SnowParam)

if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

group_equal_values <- c(regressions = "regressions", none = "none")

tasks <- list()
for (scale_bp in scales) {
  for (m in names(model_texts)) {
    for (ge in group_equal_values) {
      tasks[[length(tasks) + 1L]] <- list(scale = scale_bp, model = m, group.equal = ge)
    }
  }
}

# Worker ---------------------------------------------------------------------

run_task <- function(task) {
  scale_bp <- task$scale
  m <- task$model
  ge <- task$group.equal
  msg_tag <- paste0("scale=", scale_bp, " model=", m, " group.equal=", ge)

  tryCatch({
    message("[", Sys.getpid(), "] Starting ", msg_tag)

    # Validate and copy dt_whitened for worker-local use
    dt_scale <- validate_dt_whitened(dt_whitened)

    # Get model text and variables; build expected whitened column names
    model_txt <- model_texts[[m]]
    if (is.null(model_txt)) {
      warning(msg_tag, " - model text not found for model id: ", m)
      return(list(success = FALSE, reason = "model_missing", task = task))
    }
    model_vars <- extract_model_vars(model_txt)
    if (length(model_vars) == 0L) {
      warning(msg_tag, " - no variables extracted from model text")
      return(list(success = FALSE, reason = "no_model_vars", task = task))
    }

    whitened_vars <- paste0(model_vars, "_wh")
    missing_wcols <- setdiff(whitened_vars, names(dt_scale))
    if (length(missing_wcols) > 0) {
      warning(msg_tag, " - missing whitened cols: ", paste(missing_wcols, collapse = ", "))
      return(list(success = FALSE, reason = "missing_whitened_cols", missing = missing_wcols, task = task))
    }

    # Subset to necessary columns and complete cases
    lavaan_dt <- dt_scale[, c("chrom", whitened_vars), with = FALSE]
    lavaan_dt <- lavaan_dt[complete.cases(lavaan_dt[, ..whitened_vars])]
    n_rows <- nrow(lavaan_dt)
    if (n_rows < 20) {
      warning(msg_tag, " - too few complete rows: ", n_rows)
      return(list(success = FALSE, reason = "too_few_rows", nrows = n_rows, task = task))
    }

    # Fit model (capture lavaan errors/warnings)
    fit_obj <- tryCatch({
      sem(model_txt,
          data = lavaan_dt,
          group = "chrom",
          group.equal = ge,
          meanstructure = TRUE,
          std.ov = TRUE,
          estimator = "ML")
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(msg_tag, " - lavaan sem() error: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    })

    # Prepare output filenames (unique per task)
    suffix_ge <- ifelse(ge == "regressions", "constrained", "free")
    base_prefix <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("YRI_", m, "_", scale_bp, "bp_", suffix_ge))

    if (is.null(fit_obj)) {
      message("[", Sys.getpid(), "] Fit NULL for ", msg_tag)
      return(list(success = FALSE, reason = "fit_failed", task = task))
    }

    # 1) R2 values
    r2_vals <- tryCatch({
      r2_list <- inspect(fit_obj, "r2")
      data.frame(name = names(unlist(r2_list)), value = as.numeric(unlist(r2_list)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(msg_tag, " - inspect(...,'r2') failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL
    })
    if (!is.null(r2_vals)) safe_fwrite(r2_vals, paste0(base_prefix, "_r2.csv"), col.names = TRUE)

    # 2) Parameter estimates with CI
    pe <- tryCatch(parameterEstimates(fit_obj, ci = TRUE), error = function(e) {
      warning(msg_tag, " - parameterEstimates failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL
    })
    if (!is.null(pe)) safe_fwrite(as.data.table(pe), paste0(base_prefix, "_params.csv"))

    # 3) Fit measures
    fm <- tryCatch({
      fms <- fitMeasures(fit_obj)
      data.frame(name = names(fms), value = as.numeric(fms), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(msg_tag, " - fitMeasures failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL
    })
    if (!is.null(fm)) safe_fwrite(fm, paste0(base_prefix, "_fitmeasures.csv"), col.names = TRUE)

    # 4) Save lavaan object for later inspection
    tryCatch(saveRDS(fit_obj, file = paste0(base_prefix, "_lavaan.rds")), error = function(e) {
      warning(msg_tag, " - saveRDS failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
    })

    message("[", Sys.getpid(), "] Finished ", msg_tag, " (rows=", n_rows, ")")
    list(success = TRUE, task = task, nrows = n_rows)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("Task error (", paste(unlist(task), collapse = " | "), "): ", conditionMessage(e))
    list(success = FALSE, reason = "error", message = conditionMessage(e), task = task)
  })
}

# Run tasks in parallel ------------------------------------------------------

# Validate BPPARAM existence
if (!exists("BPPARAM")) {
  stop("BPPARAM must be defined (e.g., MulticoreParam(workers = 4) or SnowParam()).")
}

res_list <- bplapply(tasks, run_task, BPPARAM = BPPARAM)

# Summarize and write summary ------------------------------------------------

res_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(res_list, function(x) {
  data.table(
    success = isTRUE(x$success),
    reason  = x$reason %||% NA_character_,
    scale   = x$task$scale %||% NA_character_,
    model   = x$task$model %||% NA_character_,
    group.equal = x$task$group.equal %||% NA_character_,
    nrows   = as.integer(x$nrows %||% NA_integer_)
  )
}), fill = TRUE)

safe_fwrite(res_dt, file = file.path(out_dir, "parallel_fit_summary.csv"))
res_dt
```

Fit SEM

```{r, example-run, eval=T, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

# inputs
window_bp <- 1e4
tbl_10kb <- filter(human_maps_10kb, constrained_model=="phastcons")  
tbl_10kb$avg_pi <- log(tbl_10kb$avg_pi)

# because of 0's
if(any(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites==0)) {
  tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites <- log1p(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites) 
} else {
  tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites <- log(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites) 
}

tmp_B <- filter(B_10kb, constrained_model=="phastcons") %>%
         dplyr::select(., -constrained_model)

tbl_10kb <- left_join(tbl_10kb, tmp_B, by=c("chrom", 
                                            "chromStart", 
                                            "chromEnd"))

tbl_10kb <- left_join(tbl_10kb, rec_latent_10kb, by=c("chrom", 
                                                      "chromStart", 
                                                      "chromEnd"))

tbl_10kb <- left_join(tbl_10kb, mut_latent_10kb, by=c("chrom", 
                                                      "chromStart", 
                                                      "chromEnd"))

tbl_10kb <- filter(tbl_10kb, coverage >= 0.75)
names(tbl_10kb)[8:10] <- c("B", "avg_rec", "avg_mut")

table_10kb_g <- add_genome_offsets_and_midpoint(tbl_10kb, chrom_lengths = NULL)

dt <- copy(table_10kb_g) %>%
       arrange(chrom, midpoint) %>%
       as.data.table()
setDT(dt)

# Define predictor sets per variable for model_2
vars_model_2 <- list(
  avg_pi = c("B", "avg_mut", "prop_del_sites"),
  B = c("prop_del_sites", "avg_mut", "avg_rec"),
  avg_mut= c("avg_rec")
  #avg_rec = character(0),
  #prop_del_sites = character(0)
)

# auto-expand to include all variables appearing anywhere
all_targets   <- names(vars_model_2)
all_predictors <- unique(unlist(vars_model_2, use.names = FALSE))
all_vars <- sort(unique(c(all_targets, all_predictors)))

vars_all <- lapply(all_vars, function(v) {
  if (v %in% names(vars_model_2)) return(vars_model_2[[v]])
  # make explicit intercept-only so downstream code can build a valid formula
  # option: return character(0) and let make_block_specs_robust handle it
  character(0)
})
names(vars_all) <- all_vars
vars_all2 <- lapply(vars_all, function(x) if (length(x) == 0L) "1" else x)
# Note: using "1" as predictor makes formula "<var> ~ 1" (intercept-only). Use this only if builder accepts "1" as predictor token.
spec2 <- make_block_specs_robust(dt = dt, vars = vars_all2, by_chr = "chrom", window_bp = window_bp)

# For a full run you may proceed chromosome-wise. For demonstration we'll create a manageable subset:
# take up to N_per_chr windows per chromosome to make subsequent linear algebra feasible
N_per_chr <- 300
dt_sub <- dt[, .SD[seq_len(min(.N, N_per_chr))], by = chrom]
# remap block_map to dt_sub row indices by matching chr & midpoint
bm <- merge(spec2$block_map, dt_sub[, .(chrom, midpoint, sub_row = .I)], by = c("chrom", "midpoint"))
block_map_sub <- bm[, .(row_id = sub_row, chrom, midpoint, block_id)]

# Build sparse covariance blocks using decay estimates (for dt_sub)
decay_dt2 <- spec2$decay_dt

sparse_obj <- make_sparse_cov_blocks(
  block_map = block_map_sub,
  decay_dt = decay_dt2,
  dt = dt_sub,
  by_chr = "chrom",
  orig_row_col = "row_id",
  max_pair_distance = 2e5
)

vars_to_whiten <- c("avg_pi", "B", "avg_mut", "avg_rec", "prop_del_sites")
# Only whiten variables present in dt_sub
vars_to_whiten <- intersect(vars_to_whiten, names(dt_sub))
whitened_list <- lapply(vars_to_whiten, function(v) prewhiten_variable_blockwise(v, dt_sub, sparse_obj))
names(whitened_list) <- vars_to_whiten

dt_whiten <- copy(dt_sub)
# dt_whiten already a data.table and whitened_list is a named list
n <- nrow(dt_whiten)
for (nm in names(whitened_list)) {
  vec <- whitened_list[[nm]]
  if (!is.atomic(vec)) {
    warning("Skipping ", nm, ": not an atomic vector")
    next
  }
  if (length(vec) != n) {
    warning("Skipping ", nm, ": length ", length(vec), " != nrow(dt_whiten) (", n, ")")
    next
  }
  data.table::set(dt_whiten, j = nm, value = vec)
}

# Keep complete cases for the variables used in the SEM
model_vars <- c("avg_mut", "B", "prop_del_sites", "avg_rec")
model_vars <- intersect(model_vars, names(dt_whiten))
dt_whiten_complete <- dt_whiten[complete.cases(dt_whiten[, ..model_vars])]

# Fit model_2 in lavaan using whitened sample covariance
model_2_lavaan <- '
  avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
  avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
  avg_pi ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
  B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
  B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
  B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
  avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
  avg_mut ~~ 0*prop_del_sites
  mu_B_pi := c1*c5
  rec_B_pi := c2*c6
  rec_mu_pi := c1*c7
  rec_mu_B_pi := c2*c5*c7
'

fit <- sem(model_2_lavaan,
           data = dt_whiten_complete,
           std.ov = TRUE, 
           group="chrom",
           group.equal="none",
           estimator="ML")
summary(fit, fit.measures = TRUE)

```

```{r, fitting-SEM-DAGs, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
# 10 kb
for(m in unique(human_maps_10kb$constrained_model)) { 

  print(paste(m, Sys.Date(), Sys.time()), sep="\t")
  cat(paste("10kb", m))
  cat("\n")
  
  tbl_10kb <- filter(human_maps_10kb, constrained_model==m)  
  tbl_10kb$avg_pi <- log(tbl_10kb$avg_pi)
  
  # because of 0's
  if(any(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites==0)) {
    tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites <- log1p(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites) 
  } else {
    tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites <- log(tbl_10kb$prop_del_sites) 
  }
  
  tmp_B <- filter(B_10kb, constrained_model==m) %>%
           dplyr::select(., -constrained_model)
  
  tbl_10kb <- left_join(tbl_10kb, tmp_B, by=c("chrom", 
                                              "chromStart", 
                                              "chromEnd"))
  
  tbl_10kb <- left_join(tbl_10kb, rec_latent_10kb, by=c("chrom", 
                                                        "chromStart", 
                                                        "chromEnd"))
  
  tbl_10kb <- left_join(tbl_10kb, mut_latent_10kb, by=c("chrom", 
                                                        "chromStart", 
                                                        "chromEnd"))
  
  tbl_10kb <- filter(tbl_10kb, coverage > 0.75)
  names(tbl_10kb)[8:10] <- c("B", "avg_rec", "avg_mut")
  
  # modeling autocorrelation
  tbl <- copy(tbl_10kb) %>%
         mutate(midpoint=(chromStart + chromEnd) / 2) %>%
         arrange(chrom, midpoint) %>%
         as.data.table()
  
  chrom_list <- split(tbl, by="chrom")
  decay_list <- pbmclapply(chrom_list,
                           estimate_decay_per_chrom,
                           mc.cores=n_cores)
  
  decay_dt <- tibble(chrom=names(decay_list),
                   alpha=map_dbl(decay_list, "alpha"),
                   sigma2=map_dbl(decay_list, "sigma2"))
  
  tbl_blocks <- tbl[, .SD, by=chrom] %>%
  group_by(chrom) %>%
  group_map(~ make_distance_blocks(as.data.table(.x), 1e+4)) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  as.data.table()
  
  # run for all blocks (parallel)
  blocks_dt <- split(tbl_blocks, by=c("chrom", "block_id"))
  block_specs <- mclapply(blocks_dt, make_block_specs,
                          decay_dt=decay_dt,
                          max_pair_distance=max_pair_distance,
                          rho_threshold=rho_threshold,
                          mc.cores=n_cores)

  # filter non-NULL and bind wide rows
  block_specs <- compact(block_specs)
  wide_rows <- map_dfr(block_specs, function(x) {
    # remove midpoint entries before model data
    x_copy <- x
    pairs <- x_copy$pairs; x_copy$pairs <- NULL
    as_tibble(x_copy)
  })
  # attach pairs list as attribute keyed by row
  pairs_list <- map(block_specs, "pairs")
  
  # genome-wide models
  chosen_k <- 10 # block size
  wide_blocks_k <- wide_rows %>% filter(n_in_block==chosen_k)
  # retrieve corresponding pairs_list in same order
  pairs_list_k <- pairs_list[map_lgl(block_specs, ~ .x$n_in_block==chosen_k)]

  model0_k <- build_model0_for_k(chosen_k, pairs_list_k)

  m0_gw <- sem(model0_k,
               data=wide_blocks_k,
               group="chrom",
               group.equal="regressions",
               estimator="ML")

  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m0_gw, "r2"))),
                          as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m0_gw, "r2")))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG0_r2_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  fwrite(parameterestimates(m0_gw, ci=T), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG0_paqrams_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m0_gw)),
                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m0_gw))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG0_fitmeasures_10kb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  model1_k <- build_model1_for_k(chosen_k, pairs_list_k)
  
  m1gls <- sem(model1_k,
               data=tbl_10kb,
               fixed.x=F,
               std.ov=T,
               std.lv=T,
               group="chrom",
               group.equal="regressions",
               estimator="ML")
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m1gls, "r2"))),
                          as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m1gls, "r2")))),

    model_2 <- "

# 100 kb
for(m in unique(human_maps_100kb$constrained_model)) { 

  print(paste(m, Sys.Date(), Sys.time()), sep="\t")
  cat(paste("100kb", m))
  cat("\n")
  
  tbl_100kb <- filter(human_maps_100kb, constrained_model==m)  
  tbl_100kb$avg_pi <- log(tbl_100kb$avg_pi)
  
  # because of 0's
  if(any(tbl_100kb$prop_del_sites==0)) {
    tbl_100kb$prop_del_sites <- log1p(tbl_100kb$prop_del_sites) 
  } else {
    tbl_100kb$prop_del_sites <- log(tbl_100kb$prop_del_sites) 
  }
  
  tmp_B <- filter(B_100kb, constrained_model==m) %>%
           dplyr::select(., -constrained_model)
  
  tbl_100kb <- left_join(tbl_100kb, tmp_B, by=c("chrom", 
                                              "chromStart", 
                                              "chromEnd"))
  
  tbl_100kb <- left_join(tbl_100kb, rec_latent_100kb, by=c("chrom", 
                                                        "chromStart", 
                                                        "chromEnd"))
  
  tbl_100kb <- left_join(tbl_100kb, mut_latent_100kb, by=c("chrom", 
                                                        "chromStart", 
                                                        "chromEnd"))

# 1 Mb

  cat(paste("1Mb", m))
  cat("\n")
  
  tbl_1Mb <- filter(human_maps_1Mb, constrained_model==m)  
  tbl_1Mb$avg_pi <- log(tbl_1Mb$avg_pi)
  
  # because of 0's
  if(any(tbl_1Mb$prop_del_sites==0)) {
    tbl_1Mb$prop_del_sites <- log1p(tbl_1Mb$prop_del_sites) 
  } else {
    tbl_1Mb$prop_del_sites <- log(tbl_1Mb$prop_del_sites) 
  }

  rec_mu_pi:=c(y1, y2, y3, y4, y5, y6, y7, y8, y9, y10, y11, y12, y13, y14, y15, y16, y17, y18, y19, y20, y21, y22)*c7
  rec_mu_B_pi:=c(y1, y2, y3, y4, y5, y6, y7, y8, y9, y10, y11, y12, y13, y14, y15, y16, y17, y18, y19, y20, y21, y22)*c5*c7
  "
  
  m3gls_free <- sem(model_3_free,
                    data=tbl_1Mb,
                    fixed.x=F,
                    std.ov=T,
                    std.lv=T,
                    group="chrom",
                    group.equal="none",
                    estimator="GLS")
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m3gls_free, "r2"))),
                          as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m3gls_free, "r2")))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_r2_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  fwrite(parameterestimates(m3gls_free, ci=T), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_params_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m3gls_free)),
                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m3gls_free))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_fitmeasures_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, "_freechrom.csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  fwrite(lavTestLRT(m3gls, m3gls_free),
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG3_gw-equal-freechrom_1Mb_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
  
  fwrite(lavTestLRT(m2gls_free, m3gls_free),
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG2_DAG3_freechrom_1Mb_genomewide_", 
               "latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))

  m3boot <- sem(model_3,
                data=tbl_1Mb, 
                fixed.x=F,
                std.ov=T,
                std.lv=T,
                estimator="ML",
                group="chrom",
                group.equal="regressions",
                test="boot",
                se="boot")
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m3boot, "r2"))),
                          as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m3boot, "r2")))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_r2_1Mb_genomewide", 
               "_latents_", m, "_BOOT.csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)

  fwrite(parameterEstimates(m3boot, ci=F), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_params_1Mb_genomewide", 
               "_latents_", m, "_BOOT.csv", sep=""))
  
  fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m3boot)),
                          as.numeric(fitMeasures(m3boot))), 
         paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_fitmeasures_1Mb_genomewide", 
               "_latents_", m, "_BOOT.csv", sep=""),
         col.names=F)
  
  fwrite(lavTestLRT(m2boot, m3boot),
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG2_DAG3_1Mb_genomewide",
                 "_latents_", m, "_BOOT.csv", sep=""))
    
  # one model per chrom
  for(c in 1:22) {
  
    model_0 <- "
    avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c3*avg_mut
    "
    
    m0gls <- sem(model_0,
               data=filter(tbl_1Mb, chrom==c),
               fixed.x=F,
               std.ov=T,
               std.lv=T,
               estimator="GLS")
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m0gls, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m0gls, "r2"))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG0_r2_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
  
    fwrite(parameterestimates(m0gls, ci=T), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG0_params_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    model_1 <- "
    avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
    avg_pi ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
    mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
    "
    
    m1gls <- sem(model_1,
                 data=filter(tbl_1Mb, chrom==c),
                 fixed.x=F,
                 std.ov=T,
                 std.lv=T,
                 estimator="GLS")
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m1gls, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m1gls, "r2"))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_r2_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
  
    fwrite(parameterestimates(m1gls, ci=T), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG1_params_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    model_2 <- "
    avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
    avg_pi ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
    B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~~ 0*prop_del_sites
    mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
    rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
    rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
    rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
    "
    
    m2gls <- sem(model_2,
                 data=filter(tbl_1Mb, chrom==c),
                 fixed.x=F,
                 std.ov=T,
                 std.lv=T,
                 estimator="GLS")
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m2gls, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m2gls, "r2"))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG2_r2_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
  
    fwrite(parameterestimates(m2gls, ci=T), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG2_params_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m2gls)),
                            as.numeric(fitMeasures(m2gls))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG2_fitmeasures_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
    
    m2boot <- sem(model_2,
                  data=filter(tbl_1Mb, chrom==c),
                  fixed.x=F,
                  std.ov=T,
                  std.lv=T,
                  estimator="ML",
                  test="boot",
                  se="boot")
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m2boot, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m2boot, "r2"))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG2_r2_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, "_BOOT.csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
  
    fwrite(parameterEstimates(m2boot, ci=F), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG2_params_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, "_BOOT.csv", sep=""))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m2boot)),
                            as.numeric(fitMeasures(m2boot))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG2_fitmeasures_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, "_BOOT.csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
    
    model_3 <- "
    avg_pi ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
    avg_pi ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
    avg_pi ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
    B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
    B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
    avg_mut ~~ prop_del_sites
    mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
    rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
    rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
    rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
    "
    
    m3gls <- sem(model_3,
                 data=filter(tbl_1Mb, chrom==c),
                 fixed.x=F,
                 std.ov=T,
                 std.lv=T,
                 estimator="GLS")
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m3gls, "r2")),
                            as.numeric(inspect(m3gls, "r2"))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_r2_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
  
    fwrite(parameterestimates(m3gls, ci=T), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_params_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m3gls)),
                            as.numeric(fitMeasures(m3gls))), 
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG3_fitmeasures_1Mb_chr", 
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""),
           col.names=F)
    
    fwrite(lavTestLRT(m2gls, m3gls),
           paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG2_DAG3_1Mb_chr",
                 c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    m3boot <- sem(model_3,
                  data=filter(tbl_1Mb, chrom==c),
                  fixed.x=F,
                  std.ov=T,
                  std.lv=T,
                  estimator="ML",
                  test="boot",
                  se="boot")
    
    fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(inspect(m3boot, "r2")),
```

```{r SEM-human-fitmeasures, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
# per chromosome SEM models
## 10 kb
chr_fitmeasures_10kb_gls <- data.frame()
chr_fitmeasures_10kb_boot <- data.frame()
for(dag in 2:3) {
  for(m in unique(human_maps_10kb$constrained_model)) { 
    chr_list_gls <- list(length=22)
    chr_list_boot <- list(length=22)
    for(c in 1:22) {
      
      tmp <- fread(paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG", dag,
                         "_fitmeasures_10kb_chr", 
                         c, "_latents_", m, ".csv", sep=""))
      
      tmp$chrom <- c
      tmp$DAG <- dag
      tmp$constrained_model <- m
      tmp$method <- "GLS"
      
      chr_list_gls[[c]] <- tmp
      
      tmp <- fread(paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/YRI_DAG", dag, 
                         "_fitmeasures_10kb_chr", 
                         c, "_latents_", m, "_BOOT.csv", sep=""))
      
      tmp$chrom <- c
      tmp$DAG <- dag
      tmp$constrained_model <- m
      tmp$method <- "BOOT"
      
      chr_list_boot[[c]] <- tmp
    }
    
    df <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, chr_list_gls)
    chr_fitmeasures_10kb_gls <- rbind.data.frame(chr_fitmeasures_10kb_gls, df)
    
    df <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, chr_list_boot)
    chr_fitmeasures_10kb_boot <- rbind.data.frame(chr_fitmeasures_10kb_boot, df)
  }
}
chr_fitmeasures_10kb_gls$scale <- 1e+4
chr_fitmeasures_10kb_boot$scale <- 1e+4

# (Nested) model selection, genomewide models, free or equal chr regressions (LRT)
LRT_gw_freechrom_10kb <- data.frame()
for(m in unique(human_maps_10kb$constrained_model)) { 
  for(d in 2:3) { # DAGs 0 and 1 do not have enough DF to fit freechrom regressions

    tmp <- fread(paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/LRT_DAG",
                       d, "_gw-equal-freechrom_10kb_latents_", 
                       m, ".csv", sep=""))
    
    df <- as.data.frame(tmp$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],)  
    df$constrained_model <- m
    df$dag <- d
    
    LRT_gw_freechrom_10kb <- rbind.data.frame(LRT_gw_freechrom_10kb, df)
  }
}
LRT_gw_freechrom_10kb$scale <- 1e+4

                 color=constrained_model,
                 shape=method)) +
      geom_point(size=3) + theme_bw() + geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05),
                                                   linetype="dashed") +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks=pretty_breaks()) +
      scale_x_log10(breaks=c(1e+4, 1e+5, 1e+6)) +
      scale_shape_manual(values=c(0, 1, 2)) +
      scale_color_manual(values=c("purple3", "seagreen4", "brown1"),
                         name="Const. Model") +
      labs(title="LRT test of nested DAGs 2 and 3 (genome-wide)",
           x="Scale", y="-log10(p-value)") +
      theme(strip.text.y=element_text(size=16),  
            strip.text.x=element_text(size=16),   
            axis.title=element_text(size=16), 
            axis.text=element_text(size=12), 
            axis.text.x=element_text(size=12),
            legend.text=element_text(size=16),
            legend.title=element_text(size=16),
            legend.position="bottom")
save_plot("real_data_maps/gw_LRT_latent_DAGs2-3.svg", p, 
          base_height=9, base_width=14)
save_plot("real_data_maps/gw_LRT_latent_DAGs2-3.pdf", p, 
          base_height=9, base_width=14)
```

```{r SEM-human-params, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
      geom_point(size=2) + geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed") + 
      facet_grid(scale~constrained_model, labeller=label_both) + theme_bw() + 
      scale_y_continuous(breaks=pretty_breaks()) + ylim(c(-1,1)) +
      scale_x_discrete() +
      scale_color_manual(values=c("purple3", "seagreen4"),
                         name="DAG") +
      labs(title="Std. Path Coefficients to B (genome-wide model)",
           x="Variable", y="Direct Std. PC to B") +
      theme(strip.text.y=element_text(size=16),     
            strip.text.x=element_text(size=16),   
            axis.title=element_text(size=16), 
            axis.text=element_text(size=12), 
            axis.text.x=element_text(size=12),
            legend.text=element_text(size=16),
            legend.title=element_text(size=16),
            legend.position="bottom")
save_plot("real_data_maps/gw_PCs_B_DAGs2-3_latents.svg", q, 
          base_height=10, base_width=16)
save_plot("real_data_maps/gw_PCs_B_DAGs2-3_latents.pdf", q, 
          base_height=10, base_width=16)
```

## Path Models with simulated pi

Here we use simulated pi (mutational variance)

10 kb

```{r SEM-human-maps-10kb, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

human_maps_10kb <- fread("real_data_maps/maps_10kb_models.csv.gz") %>%
                   filter(., mut_map!="uniform") %>%
                   dplyr::select(-c(bin_100kb, bin_1Mb))
  
for(u in unique(human_maps_10kb$mut_map)) {
  Sys.time()
  
  cat(paste("fitting SEM(s) -- ", u, sep=""))
  cat("\n")

  for(m in unique(human_maps_10kb$constrained_model)) { 
    for(d in unique(human_maps_10kb$demo)) {
      
      tbl_10kb <- filter(human_maps_10kb,
                         coverage > 0.75,
                         mut_map==u,
                         constrained_model==m,

        rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
```

```{r SEM-human-maps-1Mb, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

human_maps_1Mb <- fread("real_data_maps/maps_1Mb_models.csv.gz")  %>%
                  filter(., mut_map!="uniform") %>%
                  dplyr::select(-c(bin_100kb, bin_1Mb))
  
for(u in unique(human_maps_1Mb$mut_map)) {
  Sys.time()
  
  cat(paste("fitting SEM(s) -- ", u, sep=""))
  cat("\n")

  for(m in unique(human_maps_1Mb$constrained_model)) { 
    for(d in unique(human_maps_1Mb$demo)) {
      
      tbl_1Mb <- filter(human_maps_1Mb,
                        coverage > 0.5,
                        mut_map==u,
                        constrained_model==m,
                        demo==d) %>%
                        dplyr::select(., -starts_with("bin_")) 
      
      tbl_1Mb_log <- cbind.data.frame(tbl_1Mb[,1:3],
                        apply(tbl_1Mb[,4:(ncol(tbl_1Mb)-4)], 2, log))
      
      # because of 0's
      if(any(tbl_1Mb$prop_del_sites==0)) {
        tbl_1Mb_log$prop_del_sites <- log1p(tbl_1Mb$prop_del_sites) 
      } else {
        tbl_1Mb_log$prop_del_sites <- log(tbl_1Mb$prop_del_sites) 
      }
      
      # genome-wide models
      model_0 <- "
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
      B ~ start(-0.25)*c3*avg_mut
      "
      
      m0gls <- sem(model_0,
                   data=tbl_1Mb_log,
                   fixed.x=F,
                   std.ov=T,
                   std.lv=T,
                   group="chrom",
                   estimator="GLS")
      
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m0gls, "r2"))),
                              as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m0gls, "r2")))), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG0_r2_1Mb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
             col.names=F)
  
      fwrite(parameterestimates(m0gls, ci=T), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG0_params_1Mb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
      
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m0gls)),
                              as.numeric(fitMeasures(m0gls))), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG0_fitmeasures_1Mb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
             col.names=F)
      
      model_1 <- "
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
      B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
      B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
      mu_B_pi:=c1*c5
      "
      
      m1gls <- sem(model_1,
                   data=tbl_1Mb_log,
                   fixed.x=F,
                   std.ov=T,
                   std.lv=T,
                   group="chrom",
                   estimator="GLS")
      
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m1gls, "r2"))),
                              as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m1gls, "r2")))), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG1_r2_1Mb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
             col.names=F)
  
      fwrite(parameterestimates(m1gls, ci=T), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG1_params_1Mb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
      
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m1gls)),
                              as.numeric(fitMeasures(m1gls))), 
             paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG1_fitmeasures_1Mb_genomewide_", 
                   d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""),
             col.names=F)
      
      model_2 <- "
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.25)*c1*avg_mut
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(0.5)*c2*B
      pi_sim_tot ~ start(-0.25)*c3*prop_del_sites
      B ~ start(-0.25)*c4*prop_del_sites
      B ~ start(-0.25)*c5*avg_mut
      B ~ start(0.25)*c6*avg_rec
      avg_mut ~ start(0.25)*c7*avg_rec
      avg_mut ~~ 0*prop_del_sites

      rec_B_pi:=c2*c6
      rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
      rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7

      m2gls <- sem(model_2,

      mu_B_pi:=c1*c5

      rec_mu_pi:=c1*c7
      rec_mu_B_pi:=c2*c5*c7
      "
      
      m3gls <- sem(model_3,
                   data=tbl_1Mb_log,
                   fixed.x=F,
                   std.ov=T,
                   std.lv=T,
                   group="chrom",
                   estimator="GLS")
      
      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(unlist(inspect(m3gls, "r2"))),
                              as.numeric(unlist(inspect(m3gls, "r2")))),

      fwrite(rbind.data.frame(names(fitMeasures(m3gls)),
```

```{r SEM-human-fitmeasures, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}

# genome-wide
## 10 kb
human_maps_10kb <- fread("real_data_maps/maps_10kb_models.csv.gz") %>%
                   filter(., mut_map!="uniform") %>%
                   dplyr::select(-c(bin_100kb, bin_1Mb))

gw_fitmeasures_10kb <- data.frame()
for(dag in 0:3) {
  for(u in unique(human_maps_100kb$mut_map)) {
    for(m in unique(human_maps_100kb$constrained_model)) { 
      for(d in unique(human_maps_100kb$demo)) {
        tmp <- fread(paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/simpi_DAG", dag, 
                           "_fitmeasures_10kb_genomewide_", 
                           d, "_", m, "_", u, ".csv", sep=""))
        
        tmp$DAG <- dag
        tmp$mut_map <- u
        tmp$constrained_model <- m
        tmp$demo <- d
        
        gw_fitmeasures_10kb <- rbind.data.frame(gw_fitmeasures_10kb, tmp)
      }
    }
  }
}
gw_fitmeasures_10kb$scale <- 1e+4
```

```{r SEM-human-params, eval=F, include=F, message=F, warning=F}
      scale_shape_manual(values=c(0, 1, 2, 3), name="Path") +
      scale_color_manual(values=c("purple3", "seagreen4", "brown1"),
                         name="Mut. Map") +
      labs(title="Indirect Path Coefficients (DAG 3, GFI > 0.95, pval_est < 0.05)",
           x="Chromosome", y="Indirect Std. PC") +
      theme(strip.text.y=element_text(size=16),        
            strip.text.x=element_text(size=16),        
            axis.title=element_text(size=16), 
            axis.text=element_text(size=12), 
            axis.text.x=element_text(size=12),
            legend.text=element_text(size=16),
            legend.title=element_text(size=16),
            legend.position="bottom")
save_plot("real_data_maps/chr_params_indirect_DAG3_simpi.svg", s, 
          base_height=10, base_width=20)
save_plot("real_data_maps/chr_params_indirect_DAG3_simpi.pdf", s, 
          base_height=10, base_width=20)

# ratios of PCs from B and Mu to Pi
chr_wide <- chr_params_ext %>% filter(., pvalue_est < 5e-2) %>%
         dplyr::select(., -c(op, label, se, z, pvalue_est, pvalue_DAG,
                             ci.lower, ci.upper)) %>%
         filter(., demo=="equilibrium", lhs=="pi_sim_tot") %>% 
         filter(., rhs=="avg_mut" | rhs=="B") %>%
         pivot_wider(values_from="est", names_from="rhs")
         #filter(., avg_mut >)
          
chr_wide$ratio_B_u <- chr_wide$B / chr_wide$avg_mut # chr 19 is weird!

r <- ggplot(data=chr_wide, 
             aes(x=chrom, 
                 y=ratio_B_u, 
                 color=mut_map,
                 alpha=gfi,
                 shape=as.factor(DAG))) +
      geom_point(size=2.5) + 
      geom_hline(yintercept=1, linetype="dashed") +
      facet_grid(scale~constrained_model, labeller=label_both) + theme_bw() + 
      scale_y_continuous(breaks=pretty_breaks()) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks=1:22) + 
      scale_shape_manual(values=c(0, 1),
                         name="DAG") +
      scale_color_manual(values=c("purple3", "seagreen4", "brown1"), 
                         name="Mut. Map") +
      labs(title="Ratio of Path Coefficients to Pi (GFI > 0.95, pval_est < 0.05)",
           x="Chromosome", y="PC(B) / PC(Mu)") +
      theme(strip.text.y=element_text(size=16),
            strip.text.x=element_text(size=16),  
            axis.title=element_text(size=16), 
            axis.text=element_text(size=12), 
            axis.text.x=element_text(size=12),
            legend.text=element_text(size=16),
            legend.title=element_text(size=16),
            legend.position="bottom")
save_plot(paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/sem_pcratios_pi_simpi.svg", sep=""),
          r, base_height=8, base_width=20)
save_plot(paste("real_data_maps/lavaan_out/sem_pcratios_pi_simpi.pdf", sep=""),
          r, base_height=8, base_width=20)
```
